literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该研究证实了几内亚所有生态区域广泛暴露于 DENV、YFV 和 WNV 的血清学证据。DENV 最高的 血清流行率 位于 N'Zerekore (43.9%),YFV 位于 Kankan (54.7%),WNV 位于 Forecariah (53.0%)。成年人,特别是农民和牲畜饲养者,表现出较高的 DENV 和 YFV 血清阳性率。在致倦库蚊中检测到西尼罗河病毒,表明其在当地 传播 中的作用。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01031-4]
疫苗 构建体的抗原性为 0.9319,全球人群覆盖率为 97.35%;与 TLR2 和 TLR4 的分子对接揭示了有希望的相互作用,最低能量分别为 -1240.5 kJ/mol 和 -1393.3 kJ/mol,MD 模拟证实了稳定性和灵活性。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0354891]
结构和动力学分析揭示了 E 蛋白如何扰乱膜结构,促进入口部位的负曲率和类似于早期半融合中间体的相邻区域的正曲率。 [10.1080/07391102.2026.2708780]
男性的 患病率 显着高于女性(23.4% vs. 原发感染占 72.4%,继发感染占 27.6%。DENV-2 占主导地位,其次是 DENV-3,与沙特阿拉伯之前报道的血清型模式一致。 [10.1007/s00284-026-05001-1]
2004 年的样本显示,基因型 I 的中和作用减少,ADE 较高,这与当时不存在的情况一致。相比之下,2017-2019 年的样本对两种基因型表现出相当的中和作用,并具有基因型和年份依赖性的 ADE 差异。 [10.1002/jmv.71079]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The study confirms widespread serological evidence of exposure to DENV, YFV, and WNV across all ecological regions of Guinea. The highest seroprevalence of DENV was in N'Zerekore (43.9%), YFV in Kankan (54.7%), and WNV in Forecariah (53.0%). [10.1186/s41182-026-01031-4]

The economic burden of dengue in Mexico is substantial, peaking in 2013 with annual costs of $176.82 million (adjusted present value: $281.60 million). All included studies reported nationwide costs, with three focusing on specific Mexican states. [10.1002/hpm.70096]

The vaccine construct showed an antigenicity of 0.9319 with 97.35% population coverage worldwide; molecular docking with TLR2 and TLR4 revealed promising interactions with lowest energies of −1240.5 kJ/mol and −1393.3 kJ/mol, respectively, and MD simulations confirmed stability and flexibility. [10.1371/journal.pone.0354891]

Structural and dynamic analyses revealed how the E protein perturbs membrane architecture, promoting negative curvature at the entry site and positive curvature in adjoining regions that resemble early hemifusion intermediates. [10.1080/07391102.2026.2708780]

Males showed significantly higher prevalence than females (23.4% vs. Primary infections accounted for 72.4%, while 27.6% were secondary. DENV-2 predominated, followed by DENV-3, consistent with previously reported serotype patterns in Saudi Arabia. [10.1007/s00284-026-05001-1]

The study confirms widespread serological evidence of exposure to DENV, YFV, and WNV across all ecological regions of Guinea. news.headline_zh: 印度批准首款登革热疫苗 Qdenga,应对日益增长的病例负担。
news.lead_zh: 印度药品监管总局(DCGI)已批准由武田制药开发的 Qdenga 疫苗,用于 4 至 60 岁人群,旨在应对该国不断上升的登革热感染和住院风险。
key_findings_zh: 印度批准了首款针对四种登革病毒血清型的疫苗 Qdenga,该疫苗在临床试验中显示出显著的预防效果 [news-7e1813ceabb9ed1d, news-a4f2255ed2acd63a]。
临床数据显示,Qdenga 在接种后 18 个月内预防住院的有效率高达 90%,且保护效果可维持长达 4.5 年 [news-8bffa2445f71beb1, news-e4beda36a5e88985]。
专家警告,疫苗接种应作为蚊虫控制措施的补充,且不建议孕妇、哺乳期妇女及免疫功能低下者使用 [news-d25484bcb1836bab, news-8bffa2445f71beb1]。
研究发现,印度多种病毒株同时传播(高流行性传播)增加了重症风险,使疫苗接种策略更具挑战性 [news-3393f587785b8b76, news-5638eccaa07e295f]。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 印度登革热病例呈上升趋势,且多种病毒株共存增加了疾病复杂性和重症风险;同时,疫苗可能在未接触过病毒的儿童中增强感染风险 [news-d25484bcb1836bab, news-495719fd8a3b4576]。
news.caveats_zh: 疫苗不能提供 100% 的保护,必须结合环境监测和防蚊措施使用;部分研究指出疫苗可能对未感染过的儿童产生抗体依赖性增强风险 [news-e4beda36a5e88985, news-495719fd8a3b4576]。
news.headline_en: India Approves First Dengue Vaccine Qdenga Amid Rising Infection Rates.
news.lead_en: India's drug regulator, the DCGI, has approved the Qdenga vaccine for individuals aged 4-60 to combat the growing burden of dengue infections across the country.
key_findings_en: India has approved Qdenga, a tetravalent vaccine targeting all four dengue virus serotypes, marking a major public health milestone [news-7e1813ceabb9ed1d, news-a4f2255ed2acd63a]
Clinical trials demonstrate Qdenga's efficacy in reducing hospitalization risk by 90% within 18 months of vaccination [news-8bffa2445f71beb1, news-e4beda36a5e88985]
Medical experts emphasize that vaccination should complement, rather than replace, comprehensive mosquito control and public awareness efforts [news-d25484bcb1836bab, news-8bffa2445f71beb1]
The emergence of hyperendemic transmission with multiple circulating strains complicates future vaccination and outbreak prediction [news-3393f587785b8b76, news-5638eccaa07e295f]
news.trend_or_risk_en: Dengue cases are rising in India, and the simultaneous circulation of multiple serotypes increases the risk of severe disease and complicates vaccination strategies [news-d25484bcb1836bab, news-495719fd8a3b4576]
news.caveats_en: The vaccine does not provide 100% protection and is not recommended for pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, or immunocompromised individuals [news-e4beda36a5e88985, news-495719fd8a3b4576]
news.brief_en: India has approved the Qdenga dengue vaccine for ages 4-60. While highly effective at reducing hospitalizations, experts warn it must be used alongside mosquito control and note potential risks for dengue-naive children.

news.en: India's drug regulator, the DCGI, has approved the Qdenga vaccine for individuals aged 4-60 to combat the growing burden of dengue infections across the country. India has approved Qdenga, a tetravalent vaccine targeting all four dengue virus serotypes, marking a major public health milestone [news-7e1813ceabb9ed1d, news-a4f2255ed2acd63a]. Clinical trials demonstrate Qdenga's efficacy in reducing hospitalization risk by 90% within 18 months of vaccination [news-8bffa2445f71beb1, news-e4beda36a5e88985]. Medical experts emphasize that vaccination should complement, rather than replace, comprehensive mosquito control and public awareness efforts [news-d25484bcb1836bab, news-8bffa2445f71beb1]. The emergence of hyperendemic transmission with multiple circulating strains complicates future vaccination and outbreak prediction [news-3393f587785b8b76, news-5638eccaa07e295f].

papers.title: Study of the circulation of dengue, yellow fever, and West Nile viruses in Guinea: implications for achieving the health objectives of the Simandou 2040 program
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Diseases such as dengue, yellow fever and West Nile virus, which are transmitted by arthropods, pose public health problems in tropical and subtropical regions. Like many West African countries, Guinea possesses all the conditions conducive to the circulation of these viruses. These include local ecology and climate, as well as the presence of vectors that transmit these viruses. Despite their medical importance, these viruses have received limited study, and up-to-date information on their circulation remains scarce. In this context, the present study examined the prevalence of these three arboviruses (DENV, YFV and WNV) in human and vector populations. METHODOLOGY: This study covered 18 Guinea prefectures, which are spread across the country's four ecological zones. The study was conducted from 27 May to 27 November 2024. In health centers selected in each prefecture, 5 ml samples of venous blood were collected from asymptomatic patients aged 1-90 years who had visited for consultations and had given their consent. Additionally, mosquitoes were collected via an "AMPLECTA MOSQUITO TRAP" light trap. Two ELISA tests were performed on the blood samples: the first for detection and the second for confirmation of the presence of these viruses in human serum. The mosquito samples were analyzed to determine diversity, and real-time PCR was employed to check for viral infection in the vectors following viral RNA extraction via the RIBO-prep AmpliSens® Kit. RESULTS: Serological evidence of exposure to all three viruses in the eighteen surveyed prefectures indicates their widespread distribution across the country. The highest seroprevalence of dengue virus antibodies was observed in N'Zerekore (43.9% [38.5-49.4%]), whereas the highest seroprevalence of yellow fever virus antibodies was recorded in Kankan Prefecture (54.7%; 95% CI: 41.5-67.3). In Forecariah, up to 53.0% (95% CI: 42.4-63.4) of participants were seropositive for West Nile virus antibodies. Seropositivity for these arboviruses was more frequently observed among adults. Higher seroprevalence of dengue and yellow fever antibodies was also observed among farmers and livestock breeders. No dengue or yellow fever infections were detected in the vectors, whereas the Culex quinquefasciatus population was found to be infected with WNV. CONCLUSION: This study provides serological evidence of exposure to dengue, yellow fever, and West Nile viruses across all the ecological regions of the Republic of Guinea. In addition, antibodies against these viruses were detected in human populations, and arbovirus-positive mosquito pools were identified during entomological investigations. Evidence of West Nile virus was also detected in mosquito pools containing Culex quinquefasciatus, suggesting a possible role of this species in the local transmission cycle. Adult farmers and livestock breeders appear to be at the greatest risk of contracting dengue and yellow fever. These results highlight the need for an integrated arbovirus surveillance system in Guinea. This system must combine serological surveillance with entomological surveys to support the public health objectives of the Simandou 2040 program.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines the circulation of dengue virus (DENV), yellow fever virus (YFV), and West Nile virus (WNV) in Guinea, focusing on their prevalence in human and vector populations across the country's four ecological zones. The central question is to assess the serological evidence of exposure to these arboviruses and identify risk factors for infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a cross-sectional study conducted across 18 prefectures in Guinea from May to November 2024. Blood samples were collected from asymptomatic patients aged 1-90 years, and mosquitoes were collected using light traps. Serological testing was performed using ELISA, and mosquito samples were analyzed via real-time PCR. The study covered all four ecological zones of Guinea.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study confirms widespread serological evidence of exposure to DENV, YFV, and WNV across all ecological regions of Guinea. The highest seroprevalence of DENV was in N'Zerekore (43.9%), YFV in Kankan (54.7%), and WNV in Forecariah (53.0%). Adults, particularly farmers and livestock breeders, showed higher seropositivity for DENV and YFV. WNV was detected in Culex quinquefasciatus mosquitoes, suggesting its role in local transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: No DENV or YFV infections were detected in vectors, despite human seropositivity, indicating gaps in understanding vector involvement for these viruses. The study does not address the absence of DENV/YFV in vectors or the potential for silent transmission cycles. Additionally, the lack of molecular confirmation for human infections beyond serology represents a methodological limitation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings highlight the need for an integrated arbovirus surveillance system in Guinea that combines serological surveillance with entomological surveys. This system is critical for supporting the public health objectives of the Simandou 2040 program. Targeted interventions should focus on high-risk groups such as farmers and livestock breeders.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides comprehensive evidence of dengue, yellow fever, and West Nile virus circulation in Guinea, with seroprevalence rates varying by region and occupation. While WNV was detected in Culex mosquitoes, the absence of DENV/YFV in vectors despite human infections warrants further investigation. The results underscore the need for integrated surveillance systems to guide public health interventions, particularly for high-risk adult populations involved in agriculture and livestock rearing.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述考察了几内亚 登革病毒 (DENV)、黄热病病毒 (YFV) 和西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 的传播情况,重点关注其 患病率 在该国四个生态区的人类和 媒介 人群中的传播。核心问题是评估接触这些虫媒病毒的血清学证据并确定感染的危险因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一项于 2024 年 5 月至 11 月在几内亚 18 个省进行的横断面研究。从 1 岁至 90 岁的无症状患者中采集血液样本,并使用光诱捕器收集蚊子。使用 ELISA 进行血清学检测,并通过实时 PCR 分析蚊子样本。该研究涵盖了几内亚的所有四个生态区。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该研究证实了几内亚所有生态区域广泛暴露于 DENV、YFV 和 WNV 的血清学证据。DENV 最高的 血清流行率 位于 N'Zerekore (43.9%),YFV 位于 Kankan (54.7%),WNV 位于 Forecariah (53.0%)。成年人,特别是农民和牲畜饲养者,表现出较高的 DENV 和 YFV 血清阳性率。在致倦库蚊中检测到西尼罗河病毒,表明其在当地 传播 中的作用。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管人类血清呈阳性,但在 媒介 中未检测到 DENV 或 YFV 感染,这表明对这些病毒参与 媒介 的了解存在差距。该研究并未解决 媒介 中 DENV/YFV 的缺失或沉默 传播 循环的可能性。此外,血清学 之外的人类感染缺乏分子证实,这代表了方法学上的局限性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果强调了几内亚需要一个综合虫媒病毒 监测 系统,将血清学 监测 与昆虫学调查相结合。该系统对于支持西芒杜 2040 计划的公共卫生目标至关重要。有针对性的干预措施应重点关注农民和畜牧业者等高风险群体。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:通过节肢动物传播的登革热、黄热病和西尼罗河病毒等疾病给热带和亚热带地区带来了公共卫生问题。与许多西非国家一样,几内亚拥有有利于这些病毒传播的所有条件。其中包括当地的生态和气候,以及传播这些病毒的 媒介 的存在。尽管这些病毒具有医学重要性,但对其进行的研究有限,而且有关其传播的最新信息仍然很少。在此背景下,本研究检查了人类和 媒介 人群中这三种虫媒病毒(DENV、YFV 和 WNV)的 患病率。方法:本研究覆盖了几内亚的 18 个省,分布在该国的四个生态区。该研究于2024年5月27日至11月27日进行。在每个都道府县选定的卫生中心,从就诊并征得同意的1-90岁无症状患者身上采集5毫升静脉血样本。此外,通过“AMPLECTA MOSQUITO TRAP”光诱捕器收集蚊子。对血液样本进行了两次 ELISA 测试:第一次用于检测,第二次用于确认人血清中是否存在这些病毒。对蚊子样本进行分析以确定多样性,并在通过 RIBO-prep AmpliSens® 试剂盒提取病毒 RNA 后,采用实时 PCR 检查 媒介 中的病毒感染。结果:在 18 个调查县中暴露于所有三种病毒的血清学证据表明它们在全国范围内广泛分布。血清流行率 抗体的最高 血清流行率 出现在恩泽雷科雷 (43.9% [38.5-49.4%]),而黄热病病毒抗体的最高 血清流行率 出现在坎坎县 (54.7%;95% CI: 41.5-67.3)。在 Forecariah 中,高达 53.0%(95% CI:42.4-63.4)的参与者西尼罗河病毒抗体血清呈阳性。这些虫媒病毒的血清阳性在成人中更为常见。农民和牲畜饲养者中也观察到较高的登革热和黄热病抗体 血清流行率。媒介 中未检测到登革热或黄热病感染,而致倦库蚊种群则被发现感染了西尼罗河病毒。结论:这项研究提供了几内亚共和国所有生态区域暴露于登革热、黄热病和西尼罗河病毒的血清学证据。此外,在人群中检测到了针对这些病毒的抗体,并且在昆虫学调查期间发现了虫媒病毒阳性的蚊子库。在含有致倦库蚊的蚊子池中也检测到了西尼罗河病毒的证据,表明该物种在当地 传播 循环中可能发挥作用。成年农民和牲畜饲养者感染登革热和黄热病的风险似乎最大。这些结果强调了几内亚需要一个集成的虫媒病毒 监测 系统。该系统必须将血清学 监测 与昆虫学调查结合起来,以支持 Simandou 2040 计划的公共卫生目标。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述考察了几内亚 登革病毒 (DENV)、黄热病病毒 (YFV) 和西尼罗河病毒 (WNV) 的传播情况,重点关注其 患病率 在该国四个生态区的人类和 媒介 人群中的传播。核心问题是评估接触这些虫媒病毒的血清学证据并确定感染的危险因素。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一项于 2024 年 5 月至 11 月在几内亚 18 个省进行的横断面研究。从 1 岁至 90 岁的无症状患者中采集血液样本,并使用光诱捕器收集蚊子。使用 ELISA 进行血清学检测,并通过实时 PCR 分析蚊子样本。该研究涵盖了几内亚的所有四个生态区。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该研究证实了几内亚所有生态区域广泛暴露于 DENV、YFV 和 WNV 的血清学证据。DENV 最高的 血清流行率 位于 N'Zerekore (43.9%),YFV 位于 Kankan (54.7%),WNV 位于 Forecariah (53.0%)。成年人,特别是农民和牲畜饲养者,表现出较高的 DENV 和 YFV 血清阳性率。在致倦库蚊中检测到西尼罗河病毒,表明其在当地 传播 中的作用。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管人类血清呈阳性,但在 媒介 中未检测到 DENV 或 YFV 感染,这表明对这些病毒参与 媒介 的了解存在差距。该研究并未解决 媒介 中 DENV/YFV 的缺失或沉默 传播 循环的可能性。此外,血清学 之外的人类感染缺乏分子证实,这代表了方法学上的局限性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果强调了几内亚需要一个综合虫媒病毒 监测 系统,将血清学 监测 与昆虫学调查相结合。该系统对于支持西芒杜 2040 计划的公共卫生目标至关重要。有针对性的干预措施应重点关注农民和畜牧业者等高风险群体。

papers.title: Global molecular and serological evidence of dengue and chikungunya infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis of 158,608 tested participants.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are Aedes-borne arboviruses with overlapping clinical manifestations, shared vectors, and substantial diagnostic challenges in co-endemic settings. This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized published evidence on molecular detection, serological positivity, and DENV–CHIKV dual positivity/co-infection in human clinical, surveillance, and community-based study populations. Content Following PRISMA 2020 guidance, five bibliographic databases (PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar) and supplementary grey-literature/preprint sources were searched for English-language studies published from 1 January 1980 to 31 December 2024. No prospective PROSPERO or OSF protocol registration was available. Eligible records reported extractable numerators and denominators for DENV and/or CHIKV in humans using recognized molecular or serological assays. A total of 196 studies comprising 158,608 tested or suspected participants were included in the extraction table. The pooled CHIKV estimate was 14.0 % (95 % CI: 12.0–16.4; I 2 =97.5 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 9.8 and 15.7 %, respectively. The pooled DENV estimate was 13.8 % (95 % CI: 10.9–17.3; I 2 =99.0 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 13.1 % (95 % CI: 7.9–21.0) and 14.3 % (95 % CI: 10.2–19.8), respectively. DENV–CHIKV dual positivity/co-infection was 52.9 % (95 % CI: 48.7–57.1) among studies that tested and reported both outcomes. Country-level estimates varied widely and should be interpreted as summaries of available studies rather than nationally representative burden estimates. Funnel-plot asymmetry was statistically significant in DENV analyses but not in the overall CHIKV analysis. Summary Available evidence indicates extensive but highly heterogeneous DENV and CHIKV positivity across selected clinical and surveillance populations. The pooled estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of substantial between-study heterogeneity, diagnostic variability, outbreak-period sampling, and uneven geographic representation. Outlook The findings support integrated arboviral surveillance, multiplex diagnostics, and vector-control preparedness in co-endemic regions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized molecular and serological evidence of dengue (DENV) and chikungunya (CHIKV) infections across 196 studies involving 158,608 participants. Pooled estimates showed DENV positivity at 13.8% (95% CI: 10.9–17.3) and CHIKV at 14.0% (95% CI: 12.0–16.4), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 >97%). Dual positivity reached 52.9% in co-endemic settings. Country-level estimates varied widely, reflecting diagnostic variability and uneven geographic representation. The findings underscore the need for integrated arboviral surveillance, multiplex diagnostics, and vector-control preparedness in regions where these viruses co-circulate.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革病毒 (DENV) 和基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,具有重叠的临床表现、共同的 媒介 以及在共流行环境中的巨大诊断挑战。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析综合了已发表的关于人类临床、监测 和社区研究人群中分子检测、血清学阳性和 DENV-CHIKV 双重阳性/合并感染的证据。根据 PRISMA 2020 指南,对 5 个书目数据库(PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、ScienceDirect 和 Google Scholar)和补充灰色文献/预印本来源进行了搜索,查找 1980 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 12 月 31 日发表的英语研究。符合条件的记录报告了使用公认的分子或方法提取的人类 DENV 和/或 CHIKV 的分子和分母。血清学测定。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled DENV estimate was 13.8 % (95 % CI: 10.9–17.3; I 2 =99.0 %), with molecular and serological estimates of 13.1 % (95 % CI: 7.9–21.0) and 14.3 % (95 % CI: 10.2–19.8), respectively. Available evidence indicates extensive but highly heterogeneous DENV and CHIKV positivity across selected clinical and surveillance populations.
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于研究间存在显着的异质性、诊断变异性、暴发 周期抽样以及不均匀的地理代表性,因此应谨慎解释汇总估计值。国家层面的估计差异很大,应解释为现有研究的总结,而不是具有全国代表性的负担估计。漏斗图不对称性在 DENV 分析中具有统计学显着性,但在整体 CHIKV 分析中并不显着。没有可用的前瞻性 PROSPERO 或 OSF 协议注册。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持在共同流行地区进行综合虫媒病毒 监测、多重诊断和 媒介 控制准备。

papers.title: Economic Impact of Dengue Virus in Mexico Over One Decade: A Systematic Literature Review (2010–2020)
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Dengue is a major mosquito‐borne viral disease worldwide, imposing significant healthcare burden on governments in countries where it is endemic, such as Mexico. This systematic review focused on studies reporting the cost of dengue in Mexico during 2010–2020. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first review discussing this topic in Mexico. We analysed all published direct costs associated with care, prevention, and surveillance, as well as indirect costs. Methods A comprehensive online search was conducted using Embase, MEDLINE, Evidence‐Based Medicine Reviews, SciELO, and LILACS. Articles reporting cost data published during 2010–2020 in English and Spanish were included. Reports from the National Ministry of Health and grey literature during the same period were also reviewed. Following the PICOS (Population, Intervention, Comparison, Outcome and Study design) framework, articles reporting direct and indirect costs were included. The National Health Service Wales tool was used to assess the quality of the studies included. Results Seven articles fulfiled the inclusion criteria. All articles reported the nationwide cost of dengue, and three focused on specific Mexican states. The dengue‐related economic burden was substantial, peaking in 2013, with annual costs of $176.82 million (adjusted present value, $281.60 million). All the searches were verified in January 2023. Conclusions The economic burden of dengue in Mexico is high and is further impacted by outbreaks, resulting in significant costs to the healthcare system and productivity losses. The heterogeneity of the methodological approaches in the cost studies reviewed makes it a challenge to compare them.

papers.title: Molecular and Serological Surveillance of Dengue Virus and Vector Dynamics in the Highlands of Southwestern Saudi Arabia
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is an emerging endemic disease in Saudi Arabia; however, important gaps remain regarding transmission dynamics, vector distribution, and serotype circulation in highland areas. This study primarily aimed to investigate dengue virus (DENV) infection and vector occurrence in the highland governorates of the Jazan region. A cross-sectional study enrolled 182 febrile patients tested using RT-qPCR, ELISA, RT-PCR-based serotyping, and rapid diagnostic tests. Concurrent entomological surveillance was conducted using CDC light traps, with morphological and molecular identification of Aedes aegypti. RT-qPCR confirmed acute DENV infection in 15.9% (29/182) of patients. Males showed significantly higher prevalence than females (23.4% vs. Primary infections accounted for 72.4%, while 27.6% were secondary. ELISA-NS1 demonstrated higher sensitivity (79.3%) and specificity (100%) than RDT-NS1 (58.6% and 99.4%), with stronger agreement with RT-qPCR (κ = 0.87 vs. IgG seropositivity (41.8%) suggests substantial prior exposure, likely reflecting ongoing endemicity rather than isolated outbreaks. DENV-2 predominated, followed by DENV-3, consistent with previously reported serotype patterns in Saudi Arabia. A total of 7,095 mosquitoes were collected, of which 20.9% were Ae. aegypti, detected year-round with peaks in August-September, likely associated with higher temperature and rainfall conditions. Monthly mosquito abundance correlated with dengue cases (r = 0.770; P = 0.006). These findings indicate that dengue transmission and vector presence extend into highland areas. Integrating molecular diagnostics with expanded vector surveillance is essential to strengthen dengue control beyond traditional endemic zones.

Concurrent entomological surveillance was conducted using CDC light traps, with morphological and molecular identification of Aedes aegypti. RT-qPCR confirmed acute DENV infection in 15.9% (29/182) of patients. Males showed significantly higher prevalence than females (23.4% vs. Primary infections accounted for 72.4%, while 27.6% were secondary. ELISA-NS1 demonstrated higher sensitivity (79.3%) and specificity (100%) than RDT-NS1 (58.6% and 99.4%), with stronger agreement with RT-qPCR (κ = 0.87 vs. IgG seropositivity (41.8%) suggests substantial prior exposure, likely reflecting ongoing endemicity rather than isolated outbreaks. papers.title: Design of a novel epitope-based tetravalent subunit vaccine against dengue virus: An immunoinformatic approach
papers.abstract: Dengue imposes a profound global impact, with millions affected annually. Its transmission by Aedes mosquitoes poses significant challenges to combat, aggravated by urbanization and climate change. Despite efforts, no impeccable antiviral treatment exists to date, highlighting the urgency for a vaccine. Developing one encounters hurdles like the four distinctive serotypes of the virus and complex immune responses. In this study, we employed an immunoinformatics approach to design an epitope-based tetravalent subunit vaccine aimed at confronting all DENV serotypes. The study contemplates epitope prediction and screening, physicochemical assessment, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, immune simulations, and in silico cloning. The vaccine construct comprises human β-defensin 3 adjuvant and 23 epitopes joined with linkers. Notably, the vaccine has an antigenicity of 0.9319 with 97.35% population coverage worldwide. Molecular docking with toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2) and TLR4 showed promising interactions with lowest energies of −1240.5 kJ/mol (76 members) and −1393.3 kJ/mol (40 members), respectively, exhibiting significant electrostatic, van dar Waals, and other interactions. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of 200 nanoseconds revealed the vaccine to be stable and flexible with the receptors. The solvent accessibility and radius of gyration were also in suitable ranges. The three-dose vaccine regimen elicited a robust and durable multi-lineage immune response, characterized by stable B and T-cell memory, sustained surveillance, and high-titer antibody production (IgM/IgG) alongside a pro-inflammatory cytokine profile (IFN-γ and IL-2) for effective antigen clearance. These findings suggest that our vaccine outperforms any other Dengue vaccine developed to date. However, since this study was conducted through in silico methods, in vitro and in vivo validations are required to confirm the vaccine as a potential candidate for clinical trials.

papers.title: Comparative Performance of Mechanistic, Statistical, and Hybrid Models of Forecasting Dengue Fever Incidence in Somalia. A Retrospective Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Dengue fever is a growing menace in Somalia, a climate change prone region with a weak healthcare system. An imperative of public health is effective forecasting models. This paper will provide a detailed comparative analysis comparing mechanistic, statistical, and hybrid models in order to find the best forecasting model to use in this data‐sparse situation of dengue fever. Methods We utilized raw reported annual incidence data of dengue (1990–2021, N = 32) obtained from Our World in Data. Due to the lack of standardized case definitions and high under‐reporting inherent to Somalia's surveillance system, forecasts represent the projected reported burden rather than true infection rates. The data was divided into a training and a testing set (1990–2016 and 2017–2021, respectively). We tested a mechanistic Susceptible‐Infected‐Recovered (SIR) model, 8 single time series models (ARIMA, ETS, TBATS, and NNAR), and 12 hybrids using an averaging ensemble strategy. Findings Although the time series models (individually) offered the basics of predictive power, the hybrid ARIMA‐TBATS model was the most successful and it surpassed the other models. It performed the highest accuracy statistics on the testing data with a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 6.49% and a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 663.81 and outperformed the best single model (TBATS) which had a MAPE of 7.14%. The basic reproduction number (R0) calculated by the SIR model was 1.015 which shows that the disease is endemic. Conclusion This paper concludes that the ARIMA‐TBATS hybrid should be the most empirically effective tool out of the ones considered when planning to forecast dengue in Somalia. Real‐World Application: This ARIMA‐TBATS framework is designed to serve as the mathematical engine for a National Dengue Early Warning System (DEWS) in Somalia, allowing public health officials to physically preempt outbreaks by routing medical supplies, mobilizing fumigation teams, and distributing bed nets to high‐risk zones months before peak incidence occurs.

papers.title: Antibody Responses in Pediatric Dengue Indicate Emergence and Co‐Circulation of DENV‐3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar and Orthoflavivirus Cross‐Reactivity
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health concern in Southeast Asia, disproportionately affecting children. In Myanmar, DENV‐3 Genotype III predominated before 2017, with Genotype I emerging thereafter. To assess the impact of this emergence on antibody responses, we analyzed paired acute and convalescent serum samples from 38 pediatric dengue patients collected between 2017 and 2019 alongside archived 2004 samples. Neutralization and in vitro antibody‐dependent enhancement (ADE) were assessed against DENV‐3 Genotypes I and III and other serotypes, with cross‐reactivity analysis to Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses. Samples from 2004 showed reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time. In contrast, 2017–2019 samples exhibited comparable neutralization for both genotypes, with genotype‐ and year‐dependent ADE differences, indicating that Genotype I emergence was associated with evolving functional antibody profiles. Hence, providing immunological evidence for continued co‐circulation of DENV‐3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar. Future prospective pediatric cohort studies with continuous surveillance of circulating orthoflaviviruses and their genotypes, are essential to elucidate how pre‐existing dengue immunity shapes genotype emergence and cross‐orthoflavivirus immunity in endemic regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health concern in Southeast Asia, disproportionately affecting children. The study aimed to understand the immunological implications of the emergence of DENV-3 Genotype I in Myanmar.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed paired acute and convalescent serum samples from 38 pediatric dengue patients collected between 2017 and 2019, alongside archived 2004 samples. It focused on DENV-3 Genotypes I and III and their impact on antibody responses in Myanmar.
analysis.methods: To assess the impact of the emergence of DENV-3 Genotype I, neutralization and in vitro antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) were evaluated against DENV-3 Genotypes I and III and other serotypes. Cross-reactivity with Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses was also analyzed.
analysis.main_results: Samples from 2004 showed reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time. In contrast, 2017–2019 samples exhibited comparable neutralization for both genotypes, with genotype- and year-dependent ADE differences.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that the emergence of Genotype I was associated with evolving functional antibody profiles. This provides immunological evidence for the continued co-circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results contribute to understanding how antibody responses evolve with the emergence of new DENV-3 genotypes, which is critical for surveillance and vaccine development in endemic regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and reliance on archived samples. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on cross-sectional analysis of antibody profiles rather than longitudinal or experimental data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the emergence and co-circulation of DENV-3 Genotypes I and III in Myanmar by analyzing antibody responses in pediatric dengue patients. Using paired serum samples from 2004 and 2017–2019, the researchers assessed neutralization and antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) against these genotypes and other serotypes, as well as cross-reactivity with Zika and Japanese encephalitis viruses. Results showed that 2004 samples had reduced neutralization and higher ADE for Genotype I, consistent with its absence at the time, while 2017–2019 samples exhibited comparable neutralization for both genotypes, with genotype- and year-dependent ADE differences. These findings suggest evolving functional antibody profiles associated with the emergence of Genotype I and provide immunological evidence for its continued co-circulation with Genotype III in Myanmar. The study's limitations include its retrospective design and reliance on archived samples, which may affect the strength of the evidence. The results have implications for understanding how pre-existing immunity influences genotype dynamics and cross-reactivity in dengue-endemic regions.

papers.title: Immune Modulatory Therapy for Severe Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever in a Patient With Mitochondrial Complex I Deficiency: A Case Report
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) poses a serious global health challenge, particularly in cases of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF). Patients with preexisting mitochondrial disorders may be at increased risk for complications due to the specific impact of DENV on mitochondrial‐dependent cellular processes and immune function. We describe a 16‐year‐old male with known mitochondrial complex I deficiency caused by a homozygous likely pathogenic variant in NDUFV1 who subsequently developed DHF. His illness was marked by rapidly worsening weakness, respiratory distress, intracranial hemorrhage, and seizures. His clinical course was further complicated by encephalitis, arachnoiditis, and myelitis requiring extensive immunomodulation. He received corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), and plasma exchange (PLEX), which led to improvement and partial recovery of functional status. This case highlights several rare complications of dengue fever, the impact of DENV on mitochondrial function, and underscores the complexity of managing infectious diseases in individuals with underlying mitochondrial disorders.
papers.journal: American Journal of Medical Genetics Part A

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们描述了一名 16 岁男性,该男性患有已知的线粒体复合物 I 缺陷,该缺陷由 NDUFV1 中的纯合可能致病性变异引起,随后患上 DHF。
elements_zh.methods: 他的临床病程因脑炎、蛛网膜炎和脊髓炎而进一步复杂化,需要广泛的免疫调节。他接受了皮质类固醇、静脉注射免疫球蛋白 (IVIG) 和血浆置换 (PLEX) 治疗,功能状态得到改善并部分恢复。
elements_zh.main_results: 他的病情迅速恶化,虚弱、呼吸困难、颅内出血和癫痫发作。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例强调了 登革热 的几种罕见并发症、DENV 对线粒体功能的影响,并强调了治疗患有潜在线粒体疾病的个体传染病的复杂性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要提高对患有线粒体疾病的登革热患者的认识和量身定制的管理策略,强调免疫调节治疗在严重病例中的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于单个 病例报告,限制了普遍性,但为线粒体复合物 I 缺乏症患者的登革热罕见并发症提供了详细的临床见解。

papers.title: Characterization of vaccine viremia, attenuation reversion, and safety: Combined results from the TAK-003 dengue vaccine clinical development program.
papers.abstract: Live-attenuated vaccines can replicate for a transient period post-vaccination and may be associated with symptoms resembling natural infection. The tetravalent dengue vaccine, TAK-003, has undergone extensive preclinical assessment to investigate vaccine RNAemia, viremia, genetic stability, and transmissibility. Here, we investigated the presence of vaccine RNAemia, attenuation loci reversions, and their association with viral-syndrome-like adverse events (AEs) in participants throughout the clinical development program. TAK-003 RNA positive serum samples were evaluated for viral replication and sequenced for reversions. Safety data (solicited AEs within 7/14 days; unsolicited AEs within 28 days) were assessed from a pooled phase 1/2 trial analysis. Participants who experienced febrile illness within 30 days post vaccination in the pivotal phase 3 DEN-301 trial and the phase 2 DEN-313 trial were tested for RNAemia and evaluated for AEs. TAK-003 RNAemia was detected in 441/805 (54.8%) of vaccinees (seronegative: 67.0%; seropositive: 33.0%) in the pooled analysis and in 39 participants with febrile illness from the DEN-301/DEN-313 trials (from 1022 febrile illnesses investigated). RNAemia peaked during the second week post-vaccination and mostly occurred after first dose. Although all four dengue virus (DENV) components were detected, RNAemia was most commonly due to DENV-2. 69 single locus reversions were detected; AEs reported in participants with reversions were generally non-serious, and not indicative of increased symptom severity. Pain at injection site (without RNAemia = 42.0%; RNAemia = 46.8%) and headache (without RNAemia = 36.6%; RNAemia = 37.6%) were the most frequently reported solicited AEs. Incidences of pain, erythema, rash, arthralgia, and fatigue were higher in participants with RNAemia. The incidence of unsolicited AEs was higher in participants with RNAemia (62.4%) than without (52.0%). In the DEN-301/DEN-313 analysis, participants with febrile illness showed a similar pattern of symptoms with and without RNAemia. The presence of RNAemia was associated with transient, mild-to-moderate symptoms, resembling natural infection, which were also observed in the absence of RNAemia.

Here, we investigated the presence of vaccine RNAemia, attenuation loci reversions, and their association with viral-syndrome-like adverse events (AEs) in participants throughout the clinical development program. TAK-003 RNA positive serum samples were evaluated for viral replication and sequenced for reversions. Safety data (solicited AEs within 7/14 days; unsolicited AEs within 28 days) were assessed from a pooled phase 1/2 trial analysis. Participants who experienced febrile illness within 30 days post vaccination in the pivotal phase 3 DEN-301 trial and the phase 2 DEN-313 trial were tested for RNAemia and evaluated for AEs. TAK-003 RNAemia was detected in 441/805 (54.8%) of vaccinees (seronegative: 67.0%; seropositive: 33.0%) in the pooled analysis and in 39 participants with febrile illness from the DEN-301/DEN-313 trials (from 1022 febrile illnesses investigated). RNAemia peaked during the second week post-vaccination and mostly occurred after first dose. Although all four dengue virus (DENV) components were detected, RNAemia was most commonly due to DENV-2. 69 single locus reversions were detected; AEs reported in participants with reversions were generally non-serious, and not indicative of increased symptom severity. Pain at injection site (without RNAemia = 42.0%; RNAemia = 46.8%) and headache (without RNAemia = 36.6%; RNAemia = 37.6%) were the most frequently reported solicited AEs. Incidences of pain, erythema, rash, arthralgia, and fatigue were higher in participants with RNAemia. The incidence of unsolicited AEs was higher in participants with RNAemia (62.4%) than without (52.0%). In the DEN-301/DEN-313 analysis, participants with febrile illness showed a similar pattern of symptoms with and without RNAemia. The presence of RNAemia was associated with transient, mild-to-moderate symptoms, resembling natural infection, which were also observed in the absence of RNAemia.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of vaccine RNAemia, attenuation loci reversions, and their association with viral-syndrome-like adverse events in participants throughout the TAK-003 dengue vaccine clinical development program, addressing concerns about live-attenuated vaccines potentially causing transient symptoms resembling natural infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The analysis included pooled phase 1/2 trial data and participants from the pivotal phase 3 DEN-301 trial and phase 2 DEN-313 trial who experienced febrile illness within 30 days post-vaccination, with TAK-003 RNA-positive serum samples evaluated for viral replication and sequenced for reversions.
analysis.methods: Safety data (solicited adverse events within 7/14 days; unsolicited adverse events within 28 days) were assessed from pooled phase 1/2 trials, and participants with febrile illness in DEN-301/DEN-313 trials were tested for RNAemia and evaluated for adverse events.
analysis.main_results: TAK-003 RNAemia was detected in 441/805 (54.8%) of vaccinees, peaking during the second week post-vaccination and mostly occurring after the first dose, with DENV-2 being the most common component detected; 69 single locus reversions were found, and adverse events in participants with reversions were generally non-serious.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that RNAemia was associated with transient, mild-to-moderate symptoms resembling natural infection, which were also observed in the absence of RNAemia, demonstrating that attenuation reversions did not indicate increased symptom severity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform that TAK-003 vaccine viremia is common but generally mild, supporting its safety profile and aiding in distinguishing vaccine-related symptoms from natural dengue infection in surveillance and clinical settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on pooled trial data and observational analysis of febrile illness cases, which may introduce selection bias, though the large sample size and comprehensive sequencing enhance reliability.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized vaccine viremia, attenuation reversion, and safety of the TAK-003 dengue vaccine across its clinical development program. RNAemia was detected in 54.8% of vaccinees, peaking in the second week post-vaccination and predominantly involving DENV-2. While 69 single locus reversions occurred, they were not associated with increased symptom severity. RNAemia was linked to transient, mild-to-moderate symptoms resembling natural infection, though similar symptoms were also seen without RNAemia. Common adverse events included injection site pain and headache, with higher incidences in RNAemic participants. The findings support the vaccine's safety profile and aid in distinguishing vaccine-related effects from natural dengue infection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 TAK-003 登革热 疫苗 临床开发计划参与者中 疫苗 RNAemia 的存在、减毒基因座逆转及其与病毒综合征样不良事件的关联,解决对减毒活 疫苗 可能导致类似于自然感染的短暂症状的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该分析包括汇总的 1/2 期试验数据以及来自关键 3 期 DEN-301 试验和 2 期 DEN-313 试验的参与者,这些参与者在 疫苗接种 后 30 天内出现发热性疾病,并对 TAK-003 RNA 阳性血清样本进行病毒复制评估和逆转测序。
elements_zh.methods: 安全性数据(7/14 天内主动不良事件;28 天内主动不良事件)通过汇总 1/2 期试验进行评估,DEN-301/DEN-313 试验中患有发热性疾病的参与者接受了 RNA 血症检测并评估了不良事件。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 疫苗 的 441/805 例 (54.8%) 中检测到 TAK-003 RNA 血症,在 疫苗接种 后第二周达到峰值,大部分发生在第一次剂量后,其中 DENV-2 是检测到的最常见成分;发现了 69 个单基因座逆转,发生逆转的参与者的不良事件通常并不严重。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,RNA 血症与类似于自然感染的短暂、轻度至中度症状相关,在没有 RNA 血症的情况下也观察到这种症状,表明衰减逆转并不表明症状严重程度增加。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,TAK-003 疫苗 病毒血症很常见,但一般较轻微,支持其安全性,并有助于在 监测 和临床环境中区分 疫苗 相关症状与自然登革热感染。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于依赖汇总试验数据和发热性疾病病例的观察分析,证据强度中等,尽管大样本量和全面测序提高了可靠性,但可能会引入选择偏差。

papers.abstract_zh: 减毒活 疫苗 可以在 疫苗接种 后短暂复制,并可能与类似自然感染的症状相关。四价登革热 疫苗(TAK-003)已接受广泛的临床前评估,以研究 疫苗 RNA 血症、病毒血症、遗传稳定性和传播性。在这里,我们研究了整个临床开发项目参与者中 疫苗 RNAemia 的存在、减毒基因座逆转及其与病毒综合征样不良事件 (AE) 的关联。对 TAK-003 RNA 阳性血清样本进行病毒复制评估和逆转测序。安全性数据(7/14 天内主动发生的 AE;28 天内主动主动发生的 AE)通过汇总 1/2 期试验分析进行评估。在关键的 3 期 DEN-301 试验和 2 期 DEN-313 试验中,在 疫苗接种 后 30 天内出现发热性疾病的参与者接受了 RNA 血症检测并评估了 AE。在汇总分析中,441/805 (54.8%) 名 疫苗 患者(血清阴性:67.0%;血清阳性:33.0%)以及 DEN-301/DEN-313 试验(调查的 1022 例发热性疾病)中的 39 名发热性疾病参与者中检测到 TAK-003 RNA 血症。RNA 血症在 疫苗接种 后第二周达到峰值,并且大多发生在第一次给药后。尽管检测到所有四种 登革病毒 (DENV) 成分,但 RNAemia 最常见的是 DENV-2。检测到 69 个单基因座回复;逆转参与者报告的 AE 一般不严重,并不表明症状严重程度增加。注射部位疼痛(无 RNA 血症 = 42.0%;RNA 血症 = 46.8%)和头痛(无 RNA 血症 = 36.6%;RNA 血症 = 37.6%)是最常报告的引起的 AE。RNA 血症参与者的疼痛、红斑、皮疹、关节痛和疲劳 发病率 较高。患有 RNA 血症的参与者 (62.4%) 中主动出现的 AE 的 发病率 高于未患有 RNA 血症的参与者 (52.0%)。在 DEN-301/DEN-313 分析中,患有发热性疾病的参与者在有或没有 RNA 血症的情况下表现出相似的症状模式。RNA 血症的存在与短暂的轻度至中度症状相关,类似于自然感染,在不存在 RNA 血症的情况下也观察到这种情况。

papers.title: Computational insights into dengue virus envelope protein triggered membrane fusion process
papers.abstract: The membrane fusion process initiated by the Envelope (E) protein of the Dengue virus (DENV) is a critical step in viral entry into host cells, yet its molecular mechanism remains only partially understood. Here, we employ a combination of all-atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to model the insertion and progression of the dengue virus Envelope protein into a lipid bilayer, capturing key stages of the membrane fusion event. All-atom simulations provide atomistic insight into initial protein-lipid interactions, time evolution of protein-lipid contacts and conformational rearrangements of the E protein fusion loop, while coarse-grained models enable observation of long-timescale membrane remodeling events, such as curvature generation. Structural and dynamic analyses reveal how the E protein perturbs the membrane architecture, promoting negative curvature in the target membrane at the site of entry and positive curvature in adjoining regions that resemble early hemifusion intermediates. These results support the hypothesis that the fusion loop acts as a membrane anchor, and that coordinated protein insertion and tilting are essential for catalyzing membrane merger. This study offers a detailed molecular view of dengue virus fusion initiation and demonstrates the value of multiscale simulation approaches in studying complex membrane-protein interactions.
papers.journal: Journal of Biomolecular Structure and Dynamics

papers.title: Substance P and NK‐1R in Dengue: A First Serological Investigation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Dengue fever lacks reliable biomarkers to explain its complex pathophysiology. Substance P (SP) and its receptor, the Neurokinin‐1 receptor (NK1R), known regulators of inflammation and vascular permeability in viral infections, may play a role in dengue but remain unexplored. Aim/Objective To investigate the levels of SP and NK1R in serum samples of diagnosed dengue patients. Methods Participants were selected from a pool of diagnosed dengue fever patients using a convenience sampling technique ( n = 40), along with a control group of healthy individuals ( n = 12). Serum samples were collected, and SP and NK1R levels were measured using enzyme‐linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Complete blood count (CBC) parameters were also evaluated. Results The mean NK1R levels in the control and case groups were 2.681 ± 3.147 and 0.57 ± 0.131, respectively. NK1R levels were significantly lower in dengue patients compared with controls ( p < 0.0001). SP levels did not differ significantly between male and female dengue patients (Mann–Whitney U = 85, p = 0.899). Conclusion NK1R may be associated with dengue pathogenesis through its potential involvement in vascular permeability, immune activation, and cytokine responses. These findings suggest a possible connection between NK1R and the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying dengue infection.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated Substance P (SP) and Neurokinin‐1 receptor (NK1R) levels in dengue patients to explore their potential role in pathophysiology. The findings suggest NK1R may be associated with dengue pathogenesis through vascular permeability and immune activation. Despite the novel serological investigation, the small sample size and convenience sampling limit generalizability. These results could inform future biomarker research and understanding of dengue complications.

papers.title_zh: 登革热中的 P 物质和 NK-1R:首次血清学研究
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background Dengue fever lacks reliable biomarkers to explain its complex pathophysiology. Substance P (SP) and its receptor, the Neurokinin‐1 receptor (NK1R), known regulators of inflammation and vascular permeability in viral infections, may play a role in dengue but remain unexplored. Aim/Objective To investigate the levels of SP and NK1R in serum samples of diagnosed dengue patients. Methods Participants were selected from a pool of diagnosed dengue fever patients using a convenience sampling technique ( n = 40), along with a control group of healthy individuals ( n = 12). Serum samples were collected, and SP and NK1R levels were measured using enzyme‐linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Complete blood count (CBC) parameters were also evaluated. Results The mean NK1R levels in the control and case groups were 2.681 ± 3.147 and 0.57 ± 0.131, respectively. NK1R levels were significantly lower in dengue patients compared with controls ( p < 0.0001). SP levels did not differ significantly between male and female dengue patients (Mann–Whitney U = 85, p = 0.899). Conclusion NK1R may be associated with dengue pathogenesis through its potential involvement in vascular permeability, immune activation, and cytokine responses. These findings suggest a possible connection between NK1R and the pathophysiological mechanisms underlying dengue infection.

papers.title: Dengue virus 2 vector competence in heatwave-exposed Aedes aegypti mosquitoes is reduced by 5-methylcytosine RNA disruption
papers.abstract: Extreme weather events can profoundly alter the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) by its primary vector, Aedes aegypti. Understanding how mosquitoes respond to heat stress and how this affects viral transmission is critical for informing global public health strategies. RNA cytosine methylation is an evolutionarily conserved stress-response mechanism in A. aegypti that links environmental perturbations to shifts in RNA metabolism and gene expression. Here, we show that a 5-day heatwave initiated at the time of DENV2 acquisition increases the lifespan of surviving mosquitoes, thereby extending the window of potential virus transmission. Heatwave-exposed mosquitoes exhibit elevated global 5-methylcytosine RNA (5mC-RNA) levels and suppressed antiviral gene expression, facilitating efficient viral replication. Pharmacological disruption of 5mC-RNA with azacytidine counteracts heatwave-induced increases in transmission potential by enhancing antiviral transcription, reducing DENV2 infection prevalence from 78% to 37%, and restoring mosquito late-life survival to rates comparable to non-stressed controls. This integrative approach reveals an epitranscriptomic mechanism by which climate extreme scenarios like heatwaves can amplify dengue transmission risk, and highlights RNA methylation as a potential target for mitigating DENV transmission.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Extreme weather events can profoundly alter the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) by its primary vector, Aedes aegypti. analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated the effects of a 5-day heatwave on Aedes aegypti mosquitoes infected with DENV2, examining changes in lifespan, viral transmission potential, and RNA methylation levels.
analysis.methods: Researchers exposed mosquitoes to a heatwave at the time of DENV2 acquisition and measured global 5-methylcytosine RNA (5mC-RNA) levels, antiviral gene expression, and viral replication. Pharmacological disruption of 5mC-RNA was performed using azacytidine to assess its impact on transmission potential.
analysis.main_results: Heatwave-exposed mosquitoes exhibited elevated global 5mC-RNA levels and suppressed antiviral gene expression, facilitating efficient viral replication. Pharmacological disruption of 5mC-RNA reduced DENV2 infection prevalence from 78% to 37% and restored mosquito late-life survival to rates comparable to non-stressed controls.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that heatwaves amplify dengue transmission risk through an epitranscriptomic mechanism involving RNA methylation, which suppresses antiviral responses. This study highlights RNA methylation as a potential target for mitigating DENV transmission under climate stress.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting RNA methylation could be a novel strategy to reduce dengue transmission during heatwaves, informing surveillance and intervention programs in regions facing climate extremes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study demonstrates a strong mechanistic link between heat stress, RNA methylation, and dengue transmission, but further research is needed to validate these findings in field settings and assess long-term ecological impacts.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how heatwaves affect dengue virus (DENV2) transmission in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The researchers found that a 5-day heatwave increases mosquito lifespan and viral replication by elevating 5-methylcytosine RNA (5mC-RNA) levels and suppressing antiviral gene expression. Pharmacological disruption of 5mC-RNA with azacytidine reduced infection prevalence from 78% to 37% and restored survival rates. The study reveals an epitranscriptomic mechanism by which heatwaves amplify dengue risk and suggests RNA methylation as a potential target for transmission control.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 极端天气事件可以通过其主要的 媒介 埃及伊蚊,深刻改变 登革病毒 (DENV) 的 传播 动态。了解蚊子如何应对热应激以及它如何影响病毒 传播 对于为全球公共卫生战略提供信息至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了为期 5 天的热浪对感染 DENV2 的埃及伊蚊的影响,检查了寿命、病毒 传播 潜力和 RNA 甲基化水平的变化。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员在获取 DENV2 时将蚊子暴露在热浪中,并测量了整体 5-甲基胞嘧啶 RNA (5mC-RNA) 水平、抗病毒药物 基因表达和病毒复制。使用氮胞苷对 5mC-RNA 进行药理学破坏,以评估其对 传播 潜力的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 暴露于热浪的蚊子表现出整体 5mC-RNA 水平升高并抑制 抗病毒药物 基因表达,促进病毒有效复制。5mC-RNA 的药理学破坏将 DENV2 感染 患病率 从 78% 降低至 37%,并将蚊子的晚年存活率恢复到与非应激对照组相当的水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,热浪通过涉及 RNA 甲基化的表观转录组机制放大了登革热 抗病毒药物 风险,RNA 甲基化抑制了 抗病毒药物 反应。这项研究强调 RNA 甲基化是在气候压力下缓解 DENV 传播 的潜在目标。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 RNA 甲基化可能是一种在热浪期间减少登革热 监测 的新策略,为面临极端气候的地区的 监测 和干预计划提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究表明热应激、RNA 甲基化和登革热 传播 之间存在很强的机制联系,但需要进一步的研究来在实地环境中验证这些发现并评估长期生态影响。

analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员在获取 DENV2 时将蚊子暴露在热浪中,并测量了整体 5-甲基胞嘧啶 RNA (5mC-RNA) 水平、抗病毒药物 基因表达和病毒复制。使用氮胞苷对 5mC-RNA 进行药理学破坏,以评估其对 传播 潜力的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 暴露于热浪的蚊子表现出整体 5mC-RNA 水平升高并抑制 抗病毒药物 基因表达,促进病毒有效复制。5mC-RNA 的药理学破坏将 DENV2 感染 患病率 从 78% 降低至 37%,并将蚊子的晚年存活率恢复到与非应激对照组相当的水平。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,热浪通过涉及 RNA 甲基化的表观转录组机制放大了登革热 抗病毒药物 风险,RNA 甲基化抑制了 抗病毒药物 反应。这项研究强调 RNA 甲基化是在气候压力下缓解 DENV 传播 的潜在目标。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 RNA 甲基化可能是一种在热浪期间减少登革热 监测 的新策略,为面临极端气候的地区的 监测 和干预计划提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究表明热应激、RNA 甲基化和登革热 传播 之间存在很强的机制联系,但需要进一步的研究来在实地环境中验证这些发现并评估长期生态影响。

papers.title: Uncovering dengue serotype-specific transmission, cross-reactivity, and immune profiles from cross-sectional serosurveys
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue remains a growing global health concern, with four co-circulating serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4). Cross-sectional serosurveys are essential for inferring past transmission and population immunity, but serotype-specific interpretation is constrained by antibody cross-reactivity across serotypes. Here, we developed a novel modelling framework to jointly infer serotype-specific force of infection (FOI) and cross-reactivity from cross-sectional serosurveys. The model is flexible to data granularity, functioning with binary serostatus alone or combined with quantitative titres. In simulations, the model effectively recovered FOI and cross-reactivity across varying endemicity, sampling designs, and sample age coverage. Applied to annual cross-sectional serosurveys in Vietnam (2013-2017), the model estimated serotype-specific FOI patterns comparable in overall magnitude to analysis requiring supplementary longitudinal post-infection antibody measurements, which are difficult to collect. We further identified higher DENV-3 transmission intensity than previously estimated. Our estimates revealed asymmetric cross-reactivity between infecting and heterologous antibody-response serotypes after primary infections, and high cross-reactivity after post-primary infections. We reconstructed population immune profiles by age, time, serotype, and past infection number, resolving single-serotype and multi-serotype exposure histories not directly distinguishable from observed seroprevalence. Our estimates showed that susceptibility to secondary infection in Vietnam peaked at approximately age 10 for each serotype, and averaged ∼25% for DENV-1 to DENV-3 and ∼30% for DENV-4 among individuals aged 1-30 years. Additionally, incorporating titres enabled individual-level infection-history inference and revealed exposure-history signals in titre profiles despite extensive cross-reactivity. These findings show that improved modelling can substantially expand the information recoverable from cross-sectional serology, strengthening the public-health utility of serosurveys for risk assessment, burden estimation, and vaccination planning.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热仍然是一个日益严重的全球健康问题,有四种共同流行的血清型(DENV-1 至 DENV-4)。横断面血清调查对于推断过去的 传播 和群体免疫力至关重要,但血清型特异性解释受到血清型间抗体交叉反应性的限制。在这里,我们开发了一种新颖的建模框架,可以从横断面血清调查中联合推断血清型特异性感染力(FOI)和交叉反应性。该模型对数据粒度非常灵活,可单独使用二元血清状态或与定量滴度结合使用。在模拟中,该模型有效地恢复了不同流行情况、抽样设计和样本年龄覆盖范围的 FOI 和交叉反应性。该模型应用于越南的年度横断面血清调查(2013-2017),估计的血清型特异性 FOI 模式在总体规模上与需要补充纵向感染后抗体测量的分析相当,而这些分析很难收集。我们进一步确定了 DENV-3 传播 强度比之前估计的更高。我们的估计揭示了初次感染后感染血清型和异源抗体反应血清型之间的不对称交叉反应性,以及初次感染后的高交叉反应性。我们根据年龄、时间、血清型和既往感染数量重建了群体免疫特征,解决了与观察到的 血清流行率 无法直接区分的单血清型和多血清型暴露史。我们的估计显示,越南每种血清型的继发感染易感性在大约 10 岁时达到峰值,在 1-30 岁的个体中,DENV-1 至 DENV-3 的平均感染率约为 25%,DENV-4 的平均感染率约为 30%。此外,尽管存在广泛的交叉反应,但合并滴度可以实现个体水平的感染史推断,并在滴度曲线中揭示暴露史信号。这些发现表明,改进的模型可以大大扩展从横截面 血清学 中可恢复的信息,加强血清调查在风险评估、负担估计和 疫苗接种 规划方面的公共卫生效用。

papers.title: Immature platelet fraction predicts differential platelet recovery trajectories in dengue fever: A longitudinal analysis
papers.abstract: Summary Dengue commonly causes thrombocytopenia, but platelet count alone may not reflect marrow thrombopoiesis. Immature platelet fraction (IPF) is a potential marker of platelet regeneration, though longitudinal data are limited. We thus aimed to evaluate whether Day 1 IPF predicts subsequent platelet recovery trajectory and to describe longitudinal trends in clinical, biochemical and platelet indices. This was a retrospective longitudinal analytical study conducted at a tertiary care hospital in Western Maharashtra, India. Six hundred and sixty‐seven patients with confirmed dengue, with platelet count, IPF and World Health Organization (WHO) classification recorded on Day 1, with follow‐up at Day 3 and 5. Log‐transformed platelet counts at Day 3 and Day 5 were analysed using generalized least squares regression. Longitudinal changes were assessed using the Friedman test. Median age was 31 years, with 81.4% males. Platelet counts declined from 118 to 98 × 10 9 /L ( p = 0.0017), while IPF increased from 9.7% to 12.9% ( p < 0.0001). Higher baseline IPF predicted faster platelet recovery ( p < 0.0001). Continued platelet decline at Day 5 was lower in the high‐IPF group than the low‐IPF group (28.6% vs. 47.8%; Kruskal–Wallis p = 0.013). We thus conclude that IPF is a dynamic biomarker that predicts platelet recovery trajectory in dengue.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热通常会导致血小板减少,但仅血小板计数可能无法反映骨髓血小板生成。本研究旨在评估第 1 天未成熟血小板分数 (IPF) 是否可以预测随后的血小板恢复轨迹,并描述临床、生化和血小板指数的纵向趋势。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项在印度西马哈拉施特拉邦一家三级护理医院进行的回顾性纵向分析研究。667 名确诊登革热患者,在第 1 天记录血小板计数、IPF 和世界卫生组织 (WHO) 分类,并在第 3 天和第 5 天进行随访。
elements_zh.methods: 使用广义最小二乘回归分析第 3 天和第 5 天的对数转换血小板计数。使用弗里德曼检验评估纵向变化。
elements_zh.main_results: 血小板计数从 118 下降至 98 × 10 9 /L ( p = 0.0017),而 IPF 从 9.7% 增加至 12.9% ( p < 0.0001)。较高的基线 IPF 预示着更快的血小板恢复 (p < 0.0001)。高 IPF 组第 5 天的血小板持续下降低于低 IPF 组(28.6% vs. 47.8%;Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.013)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,IPF 是一种动态生物标志物,可以预测登革热血小板恢复轨迹。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,IPF 可用于监测登革热患者的血小板恢复情况,可能有助于临床决策和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,基于一家三级医院的数据,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于没有随机化或对照组的观察数据。

papers.title: XPO1-dependent nuclear export regulates NS3 localization and promotes DENV-2 replication through mitochondrial remodeling and interferon suppression
papers.abstract: Nucleocytoplasmic transport is essential for cellular homeostasis and is frequently exploited by viruses during infection. Although dengue virus (DENV) non-structural protein 3 (NS3) undergoes nuclear trafficking, the role of nuclear export pathways in its localization and in viral replication remains poorly understood. Here, we show that pharmacological inhibition of exportin 1 (XPO1) promotes the accumulation of DENV-2 NS3 in both the nucleus and mitochondria of infected Huh-7 cells. XPO1 inhibition also induces mitochondrial morphological alterations resembling those observed during DENV infection. Moreover, blockade of nuclear export enhances DENV-2 replication in interferon-stimulated cells by reducing type I interferon production, suggesting the establishment of a pro-viral cellular environment. Our findings reveal that XPO1-mediated nuclear export contributes to the regulation of NS3 localization and links nuclear export to mitochondrial remodeling and suppression of antiviral signaling during DENV infection.

Here, we show that pharmacological inhibition of exportin 1 (XPO1) promotes the accumulation of DENV-2 NS3 in both the nucleus and mitochondria of infected Huh-7 cells. XPO1 inhibition also induces mitochondrial morphological alterations resembling those observed during DENV infection. Moreover, blockade of nuclear export enhances DENV-2 replication in interferon-stimulated cells by reducing type I interferon production, suggesting the establishment of a pro-viral cellular environment. Our findings reveal that XPO1-mediated nuclear export contributes to the regulation of NS3 localization and links nuclear export to mitochondrial remodeling and suppression of antiviral signaling during DENV infection.

papers.title: A tiered molecular surveillance framework linking rapid dengue detection to genomic epidemiology in Senegal.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Arboviral surveillance in Africa is limited by fragmented diagnostic capacity and insufficient integration of molecular detection with genomic epidemiology, particularly in settings where dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses co-circulate and present with overlapping clinical syndromes. METHODS: We conducted a molecular surveillance study across multiple regions in Senegal, including samples collected from 367 individuals with febrile or non-febrile illness. A tiered workflow was implemented using multiplex reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) screening for DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV, performed on a combination of individually tested samples (n=43) and pooled samples (three individuals per pool). DENV RT-qPCR-positive samples were further characterized by reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification (RT-RPA) serotyping and genomic sequencing. FINDINGS: Multiplex RT-qPCR revealed concurrent circulation of multiple arboviruses. Among individually tested samples, positivity rates were 20·9% (9/43) for DENV, 9·3% (4/43) for ZIKV, and 11·6% (5/43) for CHIKV. In pooled screening across all sites (108 pools), positivity rates were 18·5% for DENV (20/108), 5·6% for ZIKV (6/108), and 10·2% for CHIKV (11/108), indicating widespread arboviral transmission. DENV-1-4 serotyping by RT-RPA demonstrated complete concordance with RT-qPCR and identified exclusive circulation of DENV-2, enabling triage of samples for downstream genomic sequencing. Amplicon-based sequencing substantially improved genome recovery compared with metagenomic sequencing, yielding near-complete genomes in 77·8% (14/18) of RT-RPA-positive samples. Phylogenetic analyses demonstrated that all sequences clustered within the DENV-2 cosmopolitan genotype (genotype II), lineage II-F.1.1, closely related to recent strains from West Africa and Asia. Time-resolved reconstruction suggested recent emergence (∼2022-2023) and rapid expansion, consistent with ongoing transmission and regional dissemination. INTERPRETATION: These findings demonstrate co-circulation of DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV in Senegal and provide evidence of recent expansion of DENV-2 within a globally connected transmission network. A tiered strategy integrating pooled molecular screening with RT-RPA triage and genomic sequencing offers a scalable framework for arboviral surveillance in resource-limited settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a tiered molecular surveillance framework for arboviruses in Senegal, focusing on dengue virus (DENV) and its co-circulation with Zika (ZIKV) and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses. The research aimed to address the limitations of fragmented diagnostic capacity and the lack of integration between molecular detection and genomic epidemiology in Africa. A combination of multiplex RT-qPCR screening, RT-RPA serotyping, and genomic sequencing was used to analyze 367 samples, revealing concurrent circulation of DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV. Positivity rates for DENV were higher than for ZIKV and CHIKV in both individually tested and pooled samples, indicating widespread transmission. The results showed that all DENV-2 sequences clustered within the cosmopolitan genotype II, lineage II-F.1.1, and were closely related to recent strains from West Africa and Asia. These findings suggest recent emergence and rapid expansion of DENV-2 within a globally connected transmission network, highlighting the need for improved surveillance strategies. The study's tiered approach, which combines pooled screening with RT-RPA triage and genomic sequencing, offers a scalable framework for arboviral surveillance in resource-limited settings.

papers.title_zh: 塞内加尔的分层分子 监测 框架将快速登革热检测与基因组 流行病学 连接起来。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Arboviral surveillance in Africa is limited by fragmented diagnostic capacity and insufficient integration of molecular detection with genomic epidemiology, particularly in settings where dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), and chikungunya (CHIKV) viruses co-circulate and present with overlapping clinical syndromes. METHODS: We conducted a molecular surveillance study across multiple regions in Senegal, including samples collected from 367 individuals with febrile or non-febrile illness. A tiered workflow was implemented using multiplex reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) screening for DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV, performed on a combination of individually tested samples (n=43) and pooled samples (three individuals per pool). DENV RT-qPCR-positive samples were further characterized by reverse transcription recombinase polymerase amplification (RT-RPA) serotyping and genomic sequencing. FINDINGS: Multiplex RT-qPCR revealed concurrent circulation of multiple arboviruses. Among individually tested samples, positivity rates were 20·9% (9/43) for DENV, 9·3% (4/43) for ZIKV, and 11·6% (5/43) for CHIKV. In pooled screening across all sites (108 pools), positivity rates were 18·5% for DENV (20/108), 5·6% for ZIKV (6/108), and 10·2% for CHIKV (11/108), indicating widespread arboviral transmission. DENV-1-4 serotyping by RT-RPA demonstrated complete concordance with RT-qPCR and identified exclusive circulation of DENV-2, enabling triage of samples for downstream genomic sequencing. Amplicon-based sequencing substantially improved genome recovery compared with metagenomic sequencing, yielding near-complete genomes in 77·8% (14/18) of RT-RPA-positive samples. Phylogenetic analyses demonstrated that all sequences clustered within the DENV-2 cosmopolitan genotype (genotype II), lineage II-F.1.1, closely related to recent strains from West Africa and Asia. Time-resolved reconstruction suggested recent emergence (∼2022-2023) and rapid expansion, consistent with ongoing transmission and regional dissemination. INTERPRETATION: These findings demonstrate co-circulation of DENV, ZIKV, and CHIKV in Senegal and provide evidence of recent expansion of DENV-2 within a globally connected transmission network. A tiered strategy integrating pooled molecular screening with RT-RPA triage and genomic sequencing offers a scalable framework for arboviral surveillance in resource-limited settings.

papers.title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
papers.abstract: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of <20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

papers.title: Broadly cross-reactive neutralizing and enhancing antibody responses to dengue, Japanese encephalitis viruses and Zika in sera from Vietnamese pediatric dengue cases.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Understanding the balance between protective and pathogenic antibody responses is central to dengue immunology and flavivirus vaccine development. METHODS: Fifty paired acute and convalescent serum samples from pediatric dengue patients in southern Vietnam (2015-2017) were analyzed, including primary and secondary infections across a spectrum of disease severity. Primary and secondary DENV infections were classified using an in-house validated DENV IgG ELISA. Neutralizing antibody (NAb) titers and antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) activities were evaluated against dengue virus the four serotypes (DENV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) and ZIKA (ZIKV) using single-round infectious particles (SRIPs). RESULTS: Neutralizing antibody (NAb) responses were detected against all DENV serotypes and were highest against DENV-1. NAb titers increased during convalescence and were generally higher in secondary than primary infections. Higher NAb titers were also observed in convalescent sera from DSS cases compared with other clinical groups. ADE activity was most pronounced against DENV-2 and was lowest against DENV-4, while Peak enhancement titers (PET) were higher in convalescent samples, secondary infections, and DSS cases, and were positively correlated with NAb titers. Additionally, higher enhancement activity was observed in sera from DSS cases than in those from milder disease categories. Cross-reactive neutralizing and enhancing antibodies against JEV and ZIKV were also detected, with stronger enhancement observed against ZIKV. CONCLUSION: Heightened neutralizing immunity in secondary and severe dengue is accompanied by expanded enhancement potential, indicating an expanded, cross-reactive immune response driven by immune activation upon infection. The coexistence of protective and enhancing antibodies may contribute both to viral control and to immunopathogenesis during subsequent flavivirus infections.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the balance between neutralizing and enhancing antibody responses in pediatric dengue patients in southern Vietnam. It analyzes 50 paired serum samples from 2015-2017, including primary and secondary infections across varying disease severities. The research employs an in-house validated DENV IgG ELISA to classify infections and evaluates neutralizing antibody (NAb) titers and antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) activities against DENV serotypes, Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), and Zika virus (ZIKV) using single-round infectious particles (SRIPs). The results show that NAb responses are highest against DENV-1 and increase during convalescence, with secondary infections and severe dengue cases exhibiting higher titers. ADE activity is most pronounced against DENV-2 and lowest against DENV-4, with peak enhancement titers (PET) correlating with NAb levels. Sera from severe dengue cases (DSS) demonstrate higher enhancement activity compared to milder cases. Cross-reactive antibodies against JEV and ZIKV are also detected, with stronger enhancement observed against ZIKV. The authors conclude that heightened neutralizing immunity in secondary and severe dengue is associated with expanded enhancement potential, suggesting an activated immune response. They also propose that the coexistence of protective and enhancing antibodies may influence both viral control and immunopathogenesis during subsequent flavivirus infections. The study's findings may contribute to the development of more effective dengue vaccines and improve understanding of immune responses in severe cases. However, the study is limited to a specific geographic and demographic population, which may affect generalizability, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 了解保护性抗体反应和致病性抗体反应之间的平衡对于登革热免疫学和黄病毒 疫苗 开发至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对越南南部(2015-2017 年)儿科登革热患者的 50 对急性和恢复期血清样本进行了分析,包括各种疾病严重程度的原发性和继发性感染。
elements_zh.methods: 使用内部验证的 DENV IgG ELISA 对原发性和继发性 DENV 感染进行分类。使用单轮感染颗粒(SRIP)针对 登革病毒 四种血清型(DENV)、日本脑炎病毒(JEV)和 ZIKA(ZIKV)评估中和抗体(NAb)滴度和 抗体依赖性增强(ADE)活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 针对所有 DENV 血清型均检测到中和抗体 (NAb) 反应,其中针对 DENV-1 的中和抗体反应最高。Nab 滴度在恢复期增加,继发感染时的滴度通常高于原发感染时的滴度。与其他临床组相比,DSS 病例的恢复期血清中也观察到了更高的 NAB 滴度。ADE 活性针对 DENV-2 最明显,针对 DENV-4 最低,而峰值增强滴度 (PET) 在恢复期样本、继发感染和 DSS 病例中较高,并且与 NAb 滴度呈正相关。在 DSS 病例的血清中观察到的增强活性高于较轻疾病类别的血清。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 继发性和 重症登革热 中中和免疫力的增强伴随着增强潜力的扩大,表明感染时免疫激活驱动的扩大的交叉反应性 重症登革热。保护性抗体和增强性抗体的共存可能有助于病毒控制和随后黄病毒感染期间的免疫发病机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发更有效的登革热 疫苗 提供信息,并强调监测 重症登革热 患者抗体反应的重要性,以更好地了解免疫发病机制和改进 治疗 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于越南南部儿童登革热患者的血清样本,这可能会影响普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于仅抽象的分析。

analysis_zh.main_results: 针对所有 DENV 血清型均检测到中和抗体 (NAb) 反应,其中针对 DENV-1 的中和抗体反应最高。Nab 滴度在恢复期增加,继发感染时的滴度通常高于原发感染时的滴度。与其他临床组相比,DSS 病例的恢复期血清中也观察到了更高的 NAB 滴度。ADE 活性针对 DENV-2 最明显,针对 DENV-4 最低,而峰值增强滴度 (PET) 在恢复期样本、继发感染和 DSS 病例中较高,并且与 NAb 滴度呈正相关。在 DSS 病例的血清中观察到的增强活性高于较轻疾病类别的血清。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 继发性和 重症登革热 中中和免疫力的增强伴随着增强潜力的扩大,表明感染时免疫激活驱动的扩大的交叉反应性 重症登革热。保护性抗体和增强性抗体的共存可能有助于病毒控制和随后黄病毒感染期间的免疫发病机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发更有效的登革热 疫苗 提供信息,并强调监测 重症登革热 患者抗体反应的重要性,以更好地了解免疫发病机制和改进 治疗 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于越南南部儿童登革热患者的血清样本,这可能会影响普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于仅抽象的分析。

papers.title: Dengue vaccines in the real world: why long-term surveillance matters.
papers.abstract: On June 8, 2026, Brazil temporarily discontinued its current vaccination strategy with the single-dose dengue vaccine Butantan-Dengue Vaccine (Butantan-DV) when rare events after vaccination were under investigation.1–3 This pause should neither be interpreted as evidence of vaccine failure nor diminish the importance of a key advancement in dengue prevention. Rather, the pause highlights a broader lesson: for dengue vaccines, conclusions regarding efficacy, safety, and public-health benefit should not stop at regulatory approval.

analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing the context of the temporary discontinuation of the Butantan-DV vaccine, including the regulatory and public health responses to the rare events under investigation.
analysis.main_results: The main results include the temporary pause in the vaccination strategy with Butantan-DV, which was initiated due to the investigation of rare events following vaccination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the pause as a reminder that conclusions about vaccine efficacy, safety, and public health benefit should not be limited to regulatory approval, emphasizing the need for ongoing real-world monitoring.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of long-term surveillance for dengue vaccines to ensure their safety and effectiveness in real-world settings, which can inform future public health strategies and vaccine deployment.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the importance of long-term surveillance for dengue vaccines, particularly the single-dose Butantan-DV vaccine, following rare adverse events in Brazil. The temporary discontinuation of the vaccination strategy on June 8, 2026, underscores the need for ongoing monitoring beyond regulatory approval to ensure vaccine safety and public health benefit. The authors emphasize that conclusions about vaccine efficacy and safety should not be limited to initial approval but must consider real-world data. The findings suggest that such surveillance is critical for informing future public health strategies and vaccine deployment. However, the evidence is based on an abstract-only report, which limits the depth of analysis. The study provides a clear context for the temporary pause and its implications, but further research is needed to fully understand the vaccine's impact and safety profile.

elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及分析 Butantan-DV 疫苗 暂时停用的背景,包括对正在调查的罕见事件的监管和公共卫生反应。
elements_zh.main_results: 主要结果包括暂时暂停使用 Butantan-DV 的 疫苗接种 策略,该策略是由于对 疫苗接种 后罕见事件的调查而启动的。

papers.title: Prevalence and factors associated with dengue fever serotypes in Eastern Sudan: a hospital-based cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Dengue is a critical public health threat in Sudan, exacerbated by rapid urbanization and climatic factors. The 2024 outbreak in Kassala State occurred amidst a violent internal conflict and massive population displacement, synergistically accelerating transmission and complicating clinical management. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of dengue virus (DENV) serotypes and identify sociodemographic and clinical factors associated with specific serotypes among residents and internally displaced persons (IDPs) in Kassala during the 2024 epidemic. A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted at Kassala Teaching Hospital (October–December 2024). Serum samples from 227 confirmed dengue patients (RDT-positive for NS1, IgM, or both) were analyzed using one-step Real-Time PCR for serotyping. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were performed to identify factors associated with the most prevalent serotypes. Among the confirmed 227 dengue fever, DENV-2 was the dominant serotype (59.9%), followed by DENV-3 (35.2%) and DENV-1 (4.8%). Notably, 52% of patients were IDPs, and 30.4% presented with severe forms (DHF/DSS). The overall mortality rate was 6.6%, with 13 out of the 15 recorded deaths occurring among the displaced population. While a high fatality rate was noted among the small subset of DENV-1 patients (4 out of 11), this finding must be interpreted with extreme caution due to the limited sample size. Multivariate analysis revealed that the non-use of mosquito nets was the only independent factor associated with DENV-2 infection (adjusted odds ratio, AOR = 2.20; 95% CI: 1.23–3.90; P = 0.007). No significant differences were found between serotypes regarding age, gender, or displacement status. The 2024 dengue outbreak marked a significant shift from DENV-3 to DENV-2 dominance, with a high mortality burden clustering heavily within vulnerable IDPs due to systemic displacement factors rather than strain dominance. The strong association between net non-use and DENV-2 highlights the urgent need for targeted long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) distribution and vector control in displacement camps. Additionally, the high fatality rate in the small DENV-1 subset underscores the necessity of strengthened molecular surveillance to monitor virulent strains in conflict zones.
