elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是苏丹的一个严重的公共卫生威胁,快速城市化和气候因素加剧了这一威胁。本研究旨在确定 登革病毒 (DENV) 血清型的 患病率,并确定 2024 年流行期间卡萨拉居民和境内流离失所者 (IDP) 中与特定血清型相关的社会人口学和临床因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 卡萨拉教学医院进行了一项以医院为基础的横断面研究(2024 年 10 月至 12 月)。在确诊的 227 例 登革热 病例中,52% 的患者为境内流离失所者,30.4% 为重症(DHF/DSS)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用一步实时 PCR 分析 227 名确诊登革热患者(NS1、IgM 或两者均呈 RDT 阳性)的血清样本进行血清分型。进行单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析以确定与最流行血清型相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 在确诊的227例登革热病例中,DENV-2是主要血清型(59.9%),其次是DENV-3(35.2%)和DENV-1(4.8%)。总体 死亡率 率为 6.6%,记录的 15 例死亡中有 13 例发生在流离失所者中。多变量分析显示,不使用蚊帐是与 DENV-2 感染相关的唯一独立因素(调整优势比,AOR = 2.20;95% CI:1.23–3.90;P = 0.007)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 2024 年登革热 暴发 标志着从 DENV-3 到 DENV-2 主导地位的重大转变,由于系统性流离失所因素而不是毒株主导,高 死亡率 负担严重集中在易受伤害的国内流离失所者中。不使用蚊帐与 DENV-2 之间的密切关联凸显了在流离失所者营地中迫切需要有针对性地分发长效杀虫蚊帐 (LLIN) 和 媒介 控制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: DENV-1 小型亚群的高死亡率强调了加强分子 监测 来监测冲突地区毒力菌株的必要性。此外,研究结果强调需要采取有针对性的 媒介 控制措施,以减少高危人群中的登革热 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量有限,必须极其谨慎地解释一小部分 DENV-1 患者的高死亡率。证据强度中等,因为该研究为 患病率 血清型和相关因素提供了有价值的见解,但受到其横断面设计和某些血清型样本量较小的限制。

papers.title: Optimal Control Analysis and Cost – Effectiveness of Dengue Transmission Model Along With Implementation Time Effects in Applying the Control Interventions
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue fever poses a significant global public health threat, and its effective management requires a comprehensive approach to control the dengue prevalence. This study proposes an optimal control problem for the dengue transmission, incorporating three key control measures: information‐induced self‐protection, saturated treatment, and pesticide use for vector control, and is analyzed using Pontryagin's Maximum Principle. Importantly, a novel higher nonlinearity in the cost construction is incorporated. Seven distinct control policies () incorporating different combinations of control measures are designed and evaluated through numerical simulations. The results demonstrate that the combined strategy of all controls (Policy ) is the most effective, reducing infection prevalence to minimal levels within approximately 60 days, while maintaining sustained control thereafter. In comparison, the combined use of information and treatment (Policy ) achieves a similar outcome but requires nearly 120 days to stabilize the infection. Among single‐control strategies, information‐induced self‐protection (Policy ) outperforms treatment () and pesticide application () when applied alone. Cost‐effectiveness analysis using CCER, IAR, and ICER reveals that Policy is the most cost‐effective intervention, with the lowest CCER value, while Policy averts the highest number of infections. Furthermore, the analysis shows that the control's effectiveness depends strongly on epidemic severity: for mild outbreaks (), combined strategies such as and (treatment and pesticide) perform efficiently, whereas for severe outbreaks (), comprehensive control () becomes essential. Additionally, delayed implementation of control measures significantly worsens disease outcomes, increasing infection peaks and economic burden. Overall, the study highlights the importance of timely and integrated intervention strategies and provides quantitative insights for optimal resource allocation in dengue control.

papers.title: Dengue outbreak investigation in Mfandena I Health Area, Cameroon, 2025: Evidence of Aedes vectors and routine surveillance gaps
papers.abstract: Introduction: In December 2024, a sudden increase in dengue cases was reported in Mfandena I health area (HA), Yaounde, Cameroon. Two confirmed cases that escaped routine surveillance were notified, and little data were available. A multidisciplinary team was deployed to conduct active case-finding, identify potential vectors and their larval habitats, and evaluate the dengue surveillance system. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study in January 2025 (dry season) in Mfandena I HA. Cases were identified through healthcare records reviews and community screening. Suspected cases were people living in Mfandena I HA with fever >38.5°C lasting 2-7 days and at least two of the following symptoms: headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, arthralgia, skin rash, hemorrhagic manifestations since November 2024. Immunoglobulin M (IgM) and non-structural protein 1 (NS1) tests were carried out on consenting suspected cases and their contacts. An entomological survey was conducted within a 1 km radius around the case residences. We followed the CDC framework combined with the WHO IDSR approach for surveillance system evaluation. Results: We identified 46 dengue cases (44 suspected cases and 02 confirmed cases) and 16 contacts, but no additional cases were confirmed. Dengue cases were mostly women aged 21 years or older, with fever, arthralgia, and headache as main symptoms. The confirmed cases were male adults: one residing in Cameroon and one arriving from France, both presenting with fever and a red-spot rash. Among 143 Aedes mosquitoes collected, Ae. albopictus accounted for 88% (126/143). We detected a discarded tyre containing Ae. albopictus larvae as the likely source of infection. The surveillance system exhibited gaps in detection and reporting and was neither simple, acceptable, nor stable. Only 16% (4/25) of staff were familiar with the case definition, no sites had notification forms, and no cases had ever been reported. Conclusion: This investigation suggests potential dengue transmission in Mfandena I HA and highlights important surveillance gaps that limited timely detection and reporting. Strengthening surveillance capacity and reinforcing routine entomological investigations are essential to improve outbreak detection, response and prevention.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study focused on dengue virus outbreak investigation in Mfandena I Health Area, Cameroon, in 2025, with the central question being to identify evidence of Aedes vectors and evaluate routine surveillance gaps.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A cross-sectional study was conducted in January 2025 (dry season) in Mfandena I Health Area. Cases were identified through healthcare records reviews and community screening, with suspected cases defined by fever >38.5°C lasting 2-7 days and specific symptoms. Immunoglobulin M (IgM) and non-structural protein 1 (NS1) tests were performed, and an entomological survey was conducted within a 1 km radius around case residences.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The investigation confirmed 46 dengue cases (44 suspected, 2 confirmed) and identified Aedes albopictus as the primary vector (88% of collected mosquitoes). A discarded tyre containing Ae. albopictus larvae was identified as the likely infection source. The surveillance system exhibited significant gaps, with only 16% of staff familiar with case definitions and no notification forms available.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The surveillance system was found to be neither simple, acceptable, nor stable, with gaps in detection and reporting. No additional cases were confirmed among contacts, and the study was limited to the dry season, potentially missing seasonal variations in transmission or vector activity.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Strengthening surveillance capacity and reinforcing routine entomological investigations are essential to improve outbreak detection, response, and prevention. The study highlights the need for better staff training on case definitions and improved notification systems.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated a dengue outbreak in Mfandena I Health Area, Cameroon, in 2025, identifying 46 cases and confirming Aedes albopictus as the primary vector. The investigation revealed significant gaps in the surveillance system, including poor staff familiarity with case definitions and lack of notification forms. The findings emphasize the need to strengthen surveillance capacity and routine entomological investigations to improve outbreak detection and response. The study was conducted during the dry season, which may limit the generalizability of findings to other seasons.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:2024 年 12 月,喀麦隆雅温得姆凡德纳 I 卫生区 (HA) 报告登革热病例突然增加。通报了两例未按常规 监测 进行的确诊病例,但可用数据很少。部署了一个多学科团队来进行积极的病例发现,确定潜在的 媒介 及其幼虫栖息地,并评估登革热 监测 系统。方法:我们于 2025 年 1 月(旱季)在姆凡德纳 I HA 进行了一项横断面研究。病例是通过医疗记录审查和社区筛查发现的。疑似病例是自2024年11月以来居住在Mfandena I HA的人,发烧>38.5°C,持续2-7天,并且至少有以下两种症状:头痛、眼眶后疼痛、肌痛、关节痛、皮疹、出血表现。对同意的疑似病例及其接触者进行了免疫球蛋白M(IgM)和非结构蛋白1(NS1)检测。对病例住所周围1公里半径范围内进行了昆虫学调查。我们遵循 CDC 框架并结合 WHO IDSR 方法进行 监测 系统评估。结果:我们发现了 46 例登革热病例(44 例疑似病例和 02 例确诊病例)和 16 名接触者,但没有确诊其他病例。登革热病例多为21岁以上女性,以发热、关节痛、头痛为主要症状。确诊病例为成年男性:一名居住在喀麦隆,一名来自法国,两人均出现发烧和红斑皮疹症状。在收集的 143 只伊蚊中,Ae.白纹伊蚊占88%(126/143)。我们检测到一个废弃轮胎含有AE。白纹伊蚊幼虫为可能的感染源。监测 系统在检测和报告方面存在缺陷,既不简单、不可接受,也不稳定。只有 16% (4/25) 的工作人员熟悉病例定义,没有站点有通知表,也没有报告过病例。结论:这项调查表明 Mfandena I HA 中存在潜在的登革热 监测,并强调了限制及时检测和报告的重要 监测 差距。加强监测能力和加强常规昆虫学调查对于改进监测检测、应对和预防至关重要。

papers.title: Knowledge–Practice Gap, Attitudes, and Determinants of Dengue Management Practices Among Physicians in Sudan: A Cross-Sectional Study, 2026
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever is an emerging public health threat in Sudan, where recurrent outbreaks occur within a fragile and conflict-affected health system. Physicians play a central role in dengue diagnosis, management, and outbreak response. However, limited evidence exists regarding whether dengue-related knowledge translates into appropriate clinical practice. This study assessed dengue-related knowledge, attitudes, practices, and clinical readiness among physicians in Sudan and examined determinants of high dengue management practice. Methods An online cross-sectional survey was conducted among physicians practicing in Sudan between February and April 2026. A structured questionnaire adapted from a validated dengue knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) instrument was used to collect data on dengue disease knowledge, vector knowledge, attitudes, clinical practices, WHO guideline familiarity, resource availability, and healthcare-system readiness. Knowledge and practice scores were classified using Bloom’s cut-off criteria. Multivariable logistic regression was performed to identify factors independently associated with high dengue management practice. Results A total of 633 physicians participated. Only 3.8% demonstrated high disease knowledge, while 48.8% had low disease knowledge. High vector knowledge was observed in 28.8% of participants, whereas 40.0% achieved high practice scores. Important knowledge gaps were identified regarding dengue etiology, vector behavior, diagnostic testing, and breeding sites. Only 36.2% of physicians reported familiarity with WHO dengue guidelines, and 57.7% reported inadequate resources for dengue management. Correlation analysis demonstrated weak relationships between disease knowledge and practice (r = 0.077) and between vector knowledge and practice (r = 0.026), suggesting a knowledge–practice gap. In multivariable analysis, familiarity with WHO dengue guidelines (AOR = 2.66, 95% CI: 1.82–3.89), belief in the usefulness of WHO guidelines (AOR = 4.06, 95% CI: 1.94–8.51), and higher attitude scores (AOR = 1.07, 95% CI: 1.03–1.11) were independently associated with high practice, whereas disease knowledge was not. Conclusions A substantial knowledge–practice gap exists among physicians managing dengue in Sudan. Clinical practice was influenced more strongly by guideline familiarity, perceived guideline usefulness, and attitudes than by disease knowledge alone. Strengthening physician preparedness through practical training, implementation of WHO dengue guidelines, and improved health-system readiness may enhance dengue management in conflict-affected settings.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 苏丹治疗登革热的医生之间存在巨大的知识与实践差距,临床实践受指南熟悉程度、指南有用性和态度的影响比单纯的疾病知识影响更大。

papers.title: Serotypes of dengue virus and Kdr mutations (F1534C, S989P, V410L, V1016I, and V1016G) in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes from the commune of Abomey-Calavi, Southern Benin
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes of the Aedes genus, responsible for millions of cases each year. In Benin, several outbreaks have been reported, particularly in Abomey-Calavi, where the first dengue-related death was recorded in 2019. In the absence of a specific treatment, vector control remains the primary preventive measure. However, the emergence of insecticide resistance, notably through kdr mutations, could compromise its effectiveness. This study aims to identify the dengue virus serotypes circulating in the commune of Abomey-Calavi and to assess the frequency of kdr mutations V410L , V1016G , V1016I , F1534C , and S989P in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. analysis.study_design_and_population: Mosquitoes were collected in August 2024 from four arrondissements in Abomey-Calavi, with a total of 218 Aedes mosquitoes analyzed.
analysis.methods: Molecular analyses were conducted on morphologically identified mosquitoes to detect dengue virus serotypes and kdr mutations (V410L, V1016G, V1016I, F1534C, and S989P).
analysis.main_results: The dengue positivity rate was 23.39%, with DENV-3 (12.4%) being the most frequent serotype, followed by DENV-2 (6.9%), DENV-1 (5%), and DENV-4 (0.09%). Kdr mutation frequencies were 45% for V1016G, 44% for S989P, 40% for F1534C, 22% for V410L, and 19% for V1016I.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors highlighted the active circulation of dengue virus and presence of kdr mutations in Aedes mosquitoes, noting no significant association between dengue infection and kdr mutations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Regular monitoring of kdr mutations is needed to adapt vector control strategies and limit dengue spread, as insecticide resistance could compromise vector control effectiveness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to a single time point and location, but the evidence strength is moderate due to the comprehensive molecular analysis and clear reporting of serotype and mutation frequencies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated dengue virus serotypes and kdr mutations in Aedes mosquitoes from Abomey-Calavi, Benin. Mosquitoes collected in August 2024 were analyzed, revealing a 23.39% dengue positivity rate, with DENV-3 being the most prevalent serotype. Kdr mutations were detected at high frequencies, particularly V1016G (45%) and S989P (44%). No significant association was found between dengue infection and kdr mutations. The findings emphasize the need for ongoing monitoring of insecticide resistance to maintain effective vector control strategies against dengue.

papers.title_zh: 贝宁南部阿波美-卡拉维公社埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的 登革病毒 和 Kdr 突变 血清型(F1534C、S989P、V410L、V1016I 和 V1016G)
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes of the Aedes genus, responsible for millions of cases each year. In Benin, several outbreaks have been reported, particularly in Abomey-Calavi, where the first dengue-related death was recorded in 2019. In the absence of a specific treatment, vector control remains the primary preventive measure. However, the emergence of insecticide resistance, notably through kdr mutations, could compromise its effectiveness. This study aims to identify the dengue virus serotypes circulating in the commune of Abomey-Calavi and to assess the frequency of kdr mutations V410L , V1016G , V1016I , F1534C , and S989P in Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Mosquitoes were collected in August 2024 from four arrondissement Togba, Calavi, Akassato, and Godomey through morning and afternoon spraying. After morphological identification, molecular analyses were conducted to detect the viral serotypes and kdr mutations. A total of 218 Aedes mosquitoes were collected, with a predominance of Aedes aegypti (68.8%) compared to Aedes albopictus (31.2%). The overall dengue positivity rate was 23.39% (95% CI: 17.9–29.6). The most frequent serotype was DENV-3 (12.4%), followed by DENV-2 (6.9%), DENV-1 (5%), and DENV-4 (0.09%). Six mosquitoes were co-infected with two serotypes. Kdr mutations were detected in both species, with frequencies of 45% for V1016G , 44% for S989P , 40% for F1534C , 22% for V410L , and 19% for V1016I. Four mosquitoes carried three simultaneous mutations, while twenty-two carried two. These results highlight the active circulation of the dengue virus and the presence of kdr mutations in Aedes mosquitoes in Abomey-Calavi. However, no significant association was observed between dengue infection and kdr mutations, and their distribution was independent of the viral serotype. These findings emphasize the need for regular monitoring of kdr mutations to adapt vector control strategies and limit the spread of dengue.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热是一种由伊蚊属蚊子传播的病毒感染,每年造成数百万例病例。在贝宁,已报告了几起 暴发,特别是在阿波美-卡拉维,该地区于 2019 年记录了首例与登革热相关的死亡。在没有特定 治疗 的情况下,媒介 控制仍然是主要预防措施。然而,杀虫剂抗药性的出现,特别是通过 kdr 突变,可能会损害其有效性。本研究旨在鉴定在 Abomey-Calavi 公社流行的 登革病毒 血清型,并评估埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊中 kdr 突变 V410L 、 V1016G 、 V1016I 、 F1534C 和 S989P 的频率。2024 年 8 月,通过上午和下午的喷洒,从托格巴、卡拉维、阿卡萨托和戈多美四个区收集了蚊子。形态学鉴定后,进行分子分析,检测病毒血清型和kdr 突变。总共收集了 218 只伊蚊,其中埃及伊蚊 (68.8%) 占主导地位,而白纹伊蚊 (31.2%) 则占主导地位。总体登革热阳性率为 23.39%(95% CI:17.9–29.6)。最常见的血清型是 DENV-3 (12.4%),其次是 DENV-2 (6.9%)、DENV-1 (5%) 和 DENV-4 (0.09%)。六只蚊子同时感染两种血清型。Kdr 突变 在两个物种中均检测到,V1016G 的频率为 45%,S989P 的频率为 44%,F1534C 的频率为 40%,V410L 的频率为 22%,V1016I 的频率为 19%。四只蚊子同时携带三个 突变,而二十二只蚊子同时携带两个。这些结果强调了 登革病毒 的活跃循环以及阿波美-卡拉维伊蚊中 kdr 突变 的存在。然而,没有观察到登革热感染和 kdr 突变 之间存在显着关联,并且它们的分布与病毒血清型无关。这些发现强调需要定期监测 kdr 突变,以适应 媒介 控制策略并限制登革热的传播。

papers.title: Dengue Fever Unmasking JAK2 Mutation-Related Polycythemia Vera Presenting With Extensive Splanchnic Venous Thrombosis and Hemorrhagic Complications: A Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenge
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is a common arboviral infection characterized by fever, thrombocytopenia, and hemorrhagic manifestations, whereas thrombotic complications are relatively uncommon. We report a case of severe dengue infection revealing previously undiagnosed JAK2-related polycythemia vera (PV) complicated by extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis. A 58-year-old male patient with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension presented with a five-day history of fever, anorexia, and abdominal pain. Initial laboratory investigations demonstrated progressive thrombocytopenia, elevated hemoglobin, and increased hematocrit. During hospitalization, platelet counts continued to decline, and dengue serology returned positive. Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis revealed extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis involving the superior mesenteric, splenic, and portal venous systems, along with acute pancreatitis. The patient subsequently developed mucosal bleeding. Further evaluation revealed splenomegaly and a positive JAK2 V617F mutation, confirming underlying polycythemia vera. Due to concurrent bleeding and thrombosis, anticoagulation was initially deferred until hematologic stabilization was achieved. The patient was subsequently treated with anticoagulation and hydroxyurea, resulting in clinical recovery. This case highlights the rare coexistence of hemorrhagic and thrombotic complications in dengue fever and emphasizes the importance of considering underlying myeloproliferative neoplasms in patients presenting with atypical thrombosis, erythrocytosis, or splenomegaly.

papers.source_body_en: Dengue fever is a common arboviral infection characterized by fever, thrombocytopenia, and hemorrhagic manifestations, whereas thrombotic complications are relatively uncommon. We report a case of severe dengue infection revealing previously undiagnosed JAK2-related polycythemia vera (PV) complicated by extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis. A 58-year-old male patient with a history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension presented with a five-day history of fever, anorexia, and abdominal pain. Initial laboratory investigations demonstrated progressive thrombocytopenia, elevated hemoglobin, and increased hematocrit. During hospitalization, platelet counts continued to decline, and dengue serology returned positive. Computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis revealed extensive splanchnic venous thrombosis involving the superior mesenteric, splenic, and portal venous systems, along with acute pancreatitis. The patient subsequently developed mucosal bleeding. Further evaluation revealed splenomegaly and a positive JAK2 V617F mutation, confirming underlying polycythemia vera. Due to concurrent bleeding and thrombosis, anticoagulation was initially deferred until hematologic stabilization was achieved. The patient was subsequently treated with anticoagulation and hydroxyurea, resulting in clinical recovery. This case highlights the rare coexistence of hemorrhagic and thrombotic complications in dengue fever and emphasizes the importance of considering underlying myeloproliferative neoplasms in patients presenting with atypical thrombosis, erythrocytosis, or splenomegaly.

papers.title: Dengue fever outbreak in Iran: Urgent warnings and solutions
papers.abstract: Dear Editor, Following the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue fever, one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases, has become a serious public health challenge in many countries around the world in recent years. Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate. Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country’s health system. Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action. Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public. By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

Transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, this disease is prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Iran is also at risk of spreading this disease despite being located in a region with a predominantly arid and semi-arid climate. Recent reports of local cases of dengue fever in Hormozgan province, especially in Bandar Lengeh city, are a wake-up call for the country’s health system. Dengue fever is an emerging threat to public health in Iran that requires urgent and coordinated action. Controlling this disease requires the participation of all sectors of society, including the government, health institutions, and the public. By implementing scientific and sustainable strategies and in coordination with government agencies, Iran can be prevented from becoming an endemic area for dengue fever.

papers.title: Machine learning reveals temperature as a key predictor of dengue risk across Thailand's provinces: A 20-year analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever remains a critical public health challenge in Thailand, with transmission dynamics driven by complex interactions between environmental and socioeconomic factors. Understanding these predictive factors is essential for developing robust forecasting systems. METHODS: We developed a machine learning framework to classify spatiotemporal dengue risk and identify key predictive factors across Thailand. We analyzed 20 years of monthly dengue hemorrhagic fever surveillance data (2003-2022) from 77 provinces, integrating 54 environmental, climatic, and socioeconomic features. We benchmarked four candidate classifiers - logistic regression, support vector machines, random forests, and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) - and selected XGBoost on the basis of performance across six metrics. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to interpret feature contributions. The dataset was stratified into training (2003-2016) and testing periods, with the latter subdivided into pre-COVID-19 (2017-2019), COVID-19 (2020-2021), and post-COVID-19 (2022) phases. RESULTS: The XGBoost model achieved an AUC of 0.80 in pre-pandemic testing and 0.74 across the combined during- and post-pandemic period. Temperature dominated the feature-importance ranking, comprising seven of the top ten features, with non-linear thresholds near 21°C for 1-month lagged minimum temperature and near 32°C for 3-month lagged maximum temperature - values that align with established biological constraints on Aedes aegypti-mediated transmission. Precipitation features contributed minimally to model predictions, while a higher Gross Provincial Product was associated with increased dengue risk, consistent with predominantly urban transmission patterns. Model performance deteriorated significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic (AUC = 0.62 in 2021), with systematic overprediction indicating that non-environmental factors operating outside the model dominated dengue dynamics during this period. CONCLUSIONS: Temperature is the dominant predictor of dengue risk in Thailand, and the thresholds we recover correspond closely to known biological constraints on vector competence. Environmentally driven prediction is reliable under stationary conditions but degrades substantially during periods of major societal disruption, underscoring the need to integrate behavioral and surveillance-coverage indicators alongside environmental predictors when applying such models in real time.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 仍然是泰国的一项重大公共卫生挑战,传播 动态是由环境和社会经济因素之间复杂的相互作用驱动的。了解这些预测因素对于开发强大的预测系统至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了 77 个省份 20 年来每月的登革出血热 监测 数据(2003-2022 年),整合了 54 个环境、气候和社会经济特征。
elements_zh.methods: 我们开发了一个机器学习框架来对时空登革热风险进行分类并确定整个泰国的关键预测因素,对四个候选分类器进行基准测试并根据六个指标的性能选择 XGBoost。SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 用于解释特征贡献,数据集分为训练期 (2003-2016) 和测试期,后者又细分为 COVID-19 前、COVID-19 和 COVID-19 后阶段。
elements_zh.main_results: XGBoost模型在疫情前测试中达到0.80的AUC值,在疫情期间和疫情后合并期间为0.74。温度在特征重要性排名中占主导地位,1个月滞后最低温度在21°C附近,3个月滞后最高温度在32°C附近存在非线性阈值,而降水特征贡献最小。模型在COVID-19疫情期间性能显著下降(2021年AUC为0.62),系统性的过度预测表明在此期间非环境因素主导了登革热的动态变化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 温度是泰国登革热风险的主要预测因素,我们恢复的阈值与 媒介 能力的已知生物限制密切相关。该研究表明,环境驱动的预测在稳定条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱时期会大幅退化。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 环境驱动的预测在静止条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱期间会大幅退化,这强调了在实时应用此类模型时需要将行为和 监测 覆盖指标与环境预测因素结合起来。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为模型性能在 COVID-19 大流行期间显着恶化,表明模型之外的非环境因素主导了这一时期的登革热动态。所提供的证据并未报告超出观察到的性能下降的具体设计限制或偏差。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 温度是泰国登革热风险的主要预测因素,我们恢复的阈值与 媒介 能力的已知生物限制密切相关。该研究表明,环境驱动的预测在稳定条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱时期会大幅退化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 环境驱动的预测在静止条件下是可靠的,但在重大社会混乱期间会大幅退化,这强调了在实时应用此类模型时需要将行为和 监测 覆盖指标与环境预测因素结合起来。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为模型性能在 COVID-19 大流行期间显着恶化,表明模型之外的非环境因素主导了这一时期的登革热动态。所提供的证据并未报告超出观察到的性能下降的具体设计限制或偏差。

papers.title: Alignment-free k-mer-guided design of a pan-Orthoflavivirus RT-qPCR assay
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The co-circulation and rapid expansion of the genus Orthoflavivirus, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), West Nile virus (WNV), Yellow fever virus (YFV), and Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), pose significant global health challenges. Developing inclusive pan-genus molecular diagnostics is hindered by high nucleotide divergence (>25–30%) and the computational limitations of traditional multiple sequence alignment in detecting conserved motifs across large data sets. To overcome these limitations, we developed a systematic alignment-free design pipeline that uses rigorous k-mer analysis and compacted De Bruijn graphs. We analyzed 11,846 RefSeq viral genomes to identify phylogenetically conserved, functionally relevant signatures within the Orthoflavivirus genus as a case study. The pipeline identified a conserved 600 bp region within the non-structural protein 5 gene, facilitating the design of a broad-spectrum TaqMan RT-qPCR assay. Analytical validation demonstrated limits of detection (LODs) of 1–10 copies/μL for DENV1–4, ZIKV, JEV, and YFV, with no cross-reactivity against non-target pathogens; WNV was consistently detected at 1,000 copies/μL in pilot experiments. In a clinical evaluation of archived samples, the assay achieved 97.33% overall accuracy. It demonstrated 100% sensitivity and specificity for DENV serotypes, yielding significantly earlier cycle threshold (Ct) values compared to a standard commercial kit, while ZIKV detection showed 100% specificity with 71.43% sensitivity. This study validates an alignment-free, k-mer-guided strategy for uncovering conserved diagnostic targets in highly variable viral genera, followed by local MSA-assisted primer-probe design. The resulting assay offers a robust tool for broad frontline surveillance, and the computational framework provides a scalable solution for future pandemic preparedness. IMPORTANCE Mosquito-borne viruses like dengue, Zika, and West Nile pose a massive threat to global health. However, because these viruses are highly diverse and mutate rapidly, creating a single diagnostic test to detect all of them has been a challenge. Traditional software struggles to find shared genetic targets across such different viruses. To solve this, we developed a new computational approach. By analyzing over 11,000 viral genomes, we successfully identified a shared genetic signature of a group of mosquito-borne viruses. We used this discovery to create a single, highly accurate test capable of detecting multiple dangerous mosquito-borne viruses at once. This breakthrough provides a crucial, ready-to-use tool for frontline clinical diagnosis and global outbreak surveillance. More importantly, our strategy can be quickly adapted to design broad-spectrum tests for other rapidly mutating viruses, significantly strengthening our ability to prepare for and respond to future pandemics. To solve this, we developed a new computational approach.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenges of developing a broad-spectrum diagnostic test for dengue virus and other related flaviviruses due to their high genetic diversity and rapid mutation rates. analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a systematic alignment-free design pipeline using k-mer analysis and De Bruijn graphs to identify conserved genetic signatures within the Orthoflavivirus genus. It included an analytical validation phase and a clinical evaluation of archived samples.
analysis.methods: The pipeline utilized 11,846 RefSeq viral genomes to identify phylogenetically conserved, functionally relevant signatures. It also involved the design of a TaqMan RT-qPCR assay based on these signatures and an analytical validation to assess detection limits and cross-reactivity.
analysis.main_results: Analytical validation showed limits of detection (LODs) of 1–10 copies/μL for DENV1–4, ZIKV, JEV, and YFV, with no cross-reactivity against non-target pathogens. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of an alignment-free, k-mer-guided strategy for identifying conserved diagnostic targets in highly variable viral genera. This approach allows for the design of broad-spectrum diagnostic tools without relying on traditional multiple sequence alignment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a robust tool for frontline clinical diagnosis and global outbreak surveillance of dengue virus and related flaviviruses. The strategy can be adapted for other rapidly mutating viruses, enhancing pandemic preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, which may lack detailed experimental validation. The evidence strength is moderate, as the results are based on analytical validation and clinical evaluation of archived samples without real-time data.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents an alignment-free k-mer-guided design pipeline for a pan-Orthoflavivirus RT-qPCR assay, targeting dengue virus and related flaviviruses. The pipeline uses k-mer analysis and De Bruijn graphs to identify conserved genetic signatures, enabling the development of a broad-spectrum diagnostic test. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for dengue serotypes, with limits of detection ranging from 1–10 copies/μL. It also showed no cross-reactivity with non-target pathogens. The study highlights the potential of this approach for improving surveillance and diagnosis of dengue and other rapidly mutating flaviviruses, offering a scalable solution for pandemic preparedness. However, the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may limit the confidence in the results.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用 k-mer 分析和 De Bruijn 图来识别正黄病毒属内保守遗传特征的系统性免比对设计流程。它包括分析验证阶段和对存档样本的临床评估。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究结果为诊断和登革病毒及相关黄病毒的全球暴发 监测和相关黄病毒的一线临床提供了强大的工具。该策略可以适用于其他快速突变的病毒,从而增强大流行的防范能力。

papers.title: Dengue-specific T cell immunity influenced by various levels of pre-existing immunity 2267557
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus responsible for significant global morbidity and mortality. Prior exposure to different DENV serotypes can shape subsequent immune responses and influence both protection and risk. This challenges the development of a universally effective and safe dengue vaccine, capable of inducing balanced and durable immunity against all four serotypes. T cells constitute a critical arm of dengue immunity, acting independently of antibodies. In this work, we have evaluated the dengue-specific T-cell responses elicited by an attenuated monovalent DENV3 vaccine in participants with various levels of pre-existing DENV exposure. Methods Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from vaccine recipients of different dengue serostatus (seronegative, monotypic, and multitypic-exposure) were stimulated with experimentally defined DENV3 epitope megapools for DENV structural and nonstructural epitopes. We profiled T cell activation markers, memory phenotypes, and cytokine secretion using a panel of 30+ markers in high-parameter flow cytometry. Results T cells responses were analyzed longitudinally pre-vaccination, and 15, 28 and 90 days after vaccination. The DENV-3 challenge induced measurable DENV-specific T-cell responses for both structural and non-structural components. We observed individual variability in T cell responses that are influenced by their baseline serostatus and viremia burden. Conclusion Our study provides valuable insights into the factors shaping cellular immunity to a novel DENV challenge Funding Source 2P01AI106695-11 Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 是一种蚊媒黄病毒,导致全球重大发病率和 死亡率。先前接触不同的 DENV 血清型可能会影响随后的 免疫应答 并影响保护和风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究评估了减毒单价 DENV3 疫苗 在预先存在不同程度 DENV 暴露的参与者中引发的登革热特异性 T 细胞反应。该研究是在对照环境中进行的,疫苗 接受者按血清状态(血清阴性、单型和多型暴露)进行分类。
elements_zh.methods: 使用实验定义的 DENV3 表位大库刺激来自不同登革热血清状态的 疫苗 受体的外周血单核细胞 (PBMC),以获取 DENV 结构和非结构表位。在高参数流式细胞术中使用一组 30 多个标记物对 T 细胞激活标记物、记忆表型和细胞因子分泌进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 疫苗接种 之前以及 疫苗接种 后 15、28 和 90 天纵向分析 T 细胞反应。我们观察到 T 细胞反应的个体差异受到其基线血清状态和病毒血症负担的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究为塑造细胞免疫以应对新的 DENV 挑战的因素提供了宝贵的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更有效、更安全的登革热 疫苗 提供信息,该 疫苗 能够诱导针对所有四种血清型的平衡且持久的免疫力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于评估特定 疫苗 背景下的 T 细胞反应,并未涉及更广泛的影响。由于关注单一 疫苗 和有限的群体多样性,证据强度适中。

papers.title: Neutrophil Activation is Associated with Decreased Dengue Vaccine Replication in Human Recipients 2307750
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that impacts over 50% of the global population. A better understanding of DENV-specific immune responses is needed to improve vaccines. Antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis has been associated with protection against hemorrhagic fever, yet excessive neutrophil activation contributes to severe dengue, and the phenotypes of protective neutrophils remain undefined. To characterize how neutrophils respond to DENV, we evaluated neutrophil phenotypes in dengue vaccine recipients and in vitro. Methods 10 participants, with distinct DENV exposure histories, were vaccinated with a monovalent DENV3 vaccine. Cellular neutrophil markers were measured by flow cytometry at baseline (day 0) and on days 1 and 9 post-vaccination. Neutrophils from healthy donors were stimulated in vitro with different DENV serotypes, and their phenotypes were evaluated by flow cytometry. Results Following DENV3 vaccination, the total neutrophil population from all recipients showed elevated SYK and decreased CD33 expression indicating activation and maturation. When compared to participants with high vaccine viremia (N = 7), those with low viremia (N = 3) had increased expressions of CD16 and CD15 and lower CD62L on day 1. Furthermore, low viremic participants had increased CD63 in SYK positive neutrophils on day 9. In-vitro, neutrophils exposed to DENV4 survived up to 96 hours post-stimulation with no evidence of viral infection at various multiplicities of infection (MOI 1-17). Conclusion Neutrophils from participants with low viremia show increased activation, maturation and degranulation supporting their protective role in dengue. Healthy donor neutrophils responding to dengue virus in vitro will be used to characterize how sera from participants with high or low vaccine replication alters neutrophil activity. Overall, a better understanding of neutrophil responses to DENV can inform therapeutic options. Funding Source Intramural Research Program of the National Institutes of Health, NIH Bench-to-Bedside Program Funds No. 994875, NIH Director’s Challenge Innovation Award, ReVAMPP grant 1 U19 AI181960-01, and P01 AI106695. This project has also been funded in part with f Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus that impacts over 50% of the global population. A better understanding of DENV-specific immune responses is needed to improve vaccines. Antibody-dependent neutrophil phagocytosis has been associated with protection against hemorrhagic fever, yet excessive neutrophil activation contributes to severe dengue, and the phenotypes of protective neutrophils remain undefined. To characterize how neutrophils respond to DENV, we evaluated neutrophil phenotypes in dengue vaccine recipients and in vitro. Methods 10 participants, with distinct DENV exposure histories, were vaccinated with a monovalent DENV3 vaccine. Cellular neutrophil markers were measured by flow cytometry at baseline (day 0) and on days 1 and 9 post-vaccination. Neutrophils from healthy donors were stimulated in vitro with different DENV serotypes, and their phenotypes were evaluated by flow cytometry. Results Following DENV3 vaccination, the total neutrophil population from all recipients showed elevated SYK and decreased CD33 expression indicating activation and maturation. When compared to participants with high vaccine viremia (N = 7), those with low viremia (N = 3) had increased expressions of CD16 and CD15 and lower CD62L on day 1. Furthermore, low viremic participants had increased CD63 in SYK positive neutrophils on day 9. In-vitro, neutrophils exposed to DENV4 survived up to 96 hours post-stimulation with no evidence of viral infection at various multiplicities of infection (MOI 1-17). Conclusion Neutrophils from participants with low viremia show increased activation, maturation and degranulation supporting their protective role in dengue. Healthy donor neutrophils responding to dengue virus in vitro will be used to characterize how sera from participants with high or low vaccine replication alters neutrophil activity. Overall, a better understanding of neutrophil responses to DENV can inform therapeutic options. This project has also been funded in part with f Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

papers.title: Rapid initiation of standard-volume plasma exchange for acute liver failure from dengue infection.
papers.abstract: The incidence of dengue fever (DF) is rapidly rising and acute liver failure (ALF) is a rare but life-threatening associated complication. We present an adult patient who underwent standard-volume plasma exchange (PLEX) promptly after diagnosis of DF-associated ALF. PLEX of 1.5 times plasma volume was started on the same day of ALF diagnosis with the replacement fluid comprising 2.0 L of fresh frozen plasma and 1.0 L of 5% albumin. The patient's hepatic encephalopathy resolved the following day, and his biochemical profile significantly improved without additional cycles of PLEX and he was discharged well. This case report describes the rapid initiation of PLEX within hours of hepatic encephalopathy onset, using a single cycle of standard-volume PLEX alone without the influence of other therapeutic confounders. This case contributes to the evolving literature on the optimal timing and volume of PLEX in DF-ALF.

papers.title: Development of an NS1-based dengue vaccine that protects via non-neutralizing antibodies and evades antibody-dependent enhancement 2249046
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue is a mosquito-borne virus that threatens one half of the global population. While primary infection is usually mild or asymptomatic, secondary infection with another of the four serotypes increases the risk for severe disease due to a phenomenon called antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). Through ADE, non-neutralizing antibodies that target dengue structural proteins facilitate viral entry and replication and worsen disease severity and outcomes. Current dengue vaccines are live-attenuated and do not eliminate the possibility of ADE upon breakthrough infection. Novel vaccines that do not induce ADE are consequently needed. NS1 is a secreted non-structural protein that contributes to dengue pathogenesis by mediating vascular leakage. NS1 is a promising vaccine target because anti-NS1 antibodies are non-neutralizing, thereby evading ADE, and they have also been shown to protect mice from disease. Methods Here, we are developing a DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP vaccine that is safe, highly immunogenic, and effective in mice. Results This DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP vaccine induces non-neutralizing antibodies that protect against severe disease and mortality in a lethal challenge model. Conclusion In future directions, this work will investigate the mechanisms of non-neutralizing anti-NS1-based protection, including the involvement of affinity maturation and Fc effector functions. Together, we present a promising dengue vaccine strategy that evades ADE and protects against lethal disease. Funding Source Jordan Polster is supported by the HHMI Gilliam Fellows Program. David Martinez is supported by the HHMI Hanna Gray Fellows Program. Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a novel dengue vaccine strategy based on the NS1 protein, which is a secreted non-structural protein involved in dengue pathogenesis. The vaccine, developed as a DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP formulation, induces non-neutralizing antibodies that protect against severe disease and mortality in a lethal challenge model in mice. The results offer a promising direction for creating safer and more effective dengue vaccines.

analysis_zh.methods: 该研究涉及开发 DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP 疫苗 并测试其在小鼠中的免疫原性和功效。NS1 是一个有前途的 疫苗 靶点,因为抗 NS1 抗体具有非中和性,从而可以逃避 ADE,而且它们也被证明可以保护小鼠免受疾病侵害。
analysis_zh.main_results: 这种 DENV2 NS1 mRNA-LNP 疫苗 诱导非中和抗体,可在致命挑战模型中预防严重疾病和 死亡率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 因此需要不诱导 ADE 的新型 疫苗。我们共同提出了一种有前途的登革热 疫苗 策略,该策略可以逃避 ADE 并预防致命疾病。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该 疫苗 策略可以通过提供一种逃避 ADE 和预防严重疾病的方法,为未来登革热 疫苗 的发展提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。该研究基于小鼠模型的结果,不包括人体试验或长期随访。

papers.title: A Tetravalent Dengue prM-E mRNA-LNP Vaccine Protects via Antibodies in Susceptible Mice 2255808
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major global health threat, with no optimal vaccine available against its four distinct serotypes: DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, and DENV4. A central challenge in dengue vaccine development is achieving balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, as partial protection can lead to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), increasing the risk of severe disease upon secondary infection. Methods We developed a tetravalent mRNA vaccine encoding the prM-E proteins from each DENV serotype, formulated in lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). The vaccine was administered intramuscularly to C57BL/6J mice. Each dose contained a total of 5 μg mRNA (1.25 μg per serotype) and was given at 4-week intervals for three immunizations. Germinal center (GC) B cell responses and tissue-resident memory T (Trm) cell induction were analyzed in comparison with recombinant Envelope (rE) protein formulated with Alum. Results The tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicited strong neutralizing antibody responses against all four serotypes, producing titers of 5481, 4632, 12,179, and 5006 for DENV1-4, respectively. Passive transfer of sera from vaccinated mice conferred complete protection in AG129 mice (IFN-α/β/γR-/-) challenged with lethal DENV2, resulting in 100% survival. By day 14, the prM-E mRNA-LNP group exhibited a two-fold higher frequency of CD38^lowGL7+ GC B cells than the rE + Alum group, indicating enhanced GC B cell activity. Intradermal (ID) vaccination induced significantly higher Trm cell formation in the skin compared to intramuscular delivery, showing approximately four-fold increases following ID prime-boost immunization. Conclusion These findings show that the tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicits strong humoral and tissue-resident cellular immunity against all DENV serotypes. The results underscore its robust immunogenicity and protective efficacy, supporting further development of mRNA-based dengue vaccines for broad and durable protection. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 仍然是一个主要的全球健康威胁,目前还没有针对其四种不同血清型(DENV1、DENV2、DENV3 和 DENV4)的最佳 疫苗。登革热 疫苗 开发的一个核心挑战是实现针对所有血清型的平衡且持久的免疫力,因为部分保护可能导致 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),增加继发感染时发生严重疾病的风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 将编码来自每种 DENV 血清型的 prM-E 蛋白的四价 mRNA 疫苗 配制在脂质纳米颗粒 (LNP) 中,对 C57BL/6J 小鼠进行肌内注射。每剂总共含有 5 μg mRNA(每种血清型 1.25 μg),每 4 周间隔一次,进行 3 次免疫。
elements_zh.methods: 与明矾配制的重组包膜 (rE) 蛋白相比,分析了生发中心 (GC) B 细胞反应和组织驻留记忆 T (Trm) 细胞诱导。还评估了皮内 (ID) 疫苗接种 皮肤中 Trm 细胞的形成。
elements_zh.main_results: 四价 prM-E mRNA-LNP 疫苗 引发针对所有四种血清型的强烈中和抗体反应,产生的 DENV1-4 效价分别为 5481、4632、12,179 和 5006。来自接种疫苗的小鼠的血清被动转移为受到致命 DENV2 攻击的 AG129 小鼠提供了完全保护,导致 100% 存活。到第 14 天,prM-E mRNA-LNP 组表现出的 CD38^lowGL7+ GC B 细胞频率是 rE + Alum 组的两倍,并且与肌内递送相比,ID 疫苗接种 在皮肤中诱导的 Trm 细胞形成大约高四倍。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A tetravalent mRNA vaccine encoding the prM-E proteins from each DENV serotype, formulated in lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), was administered intramuscularly to C57BL/6J mice. papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major global health threat, with no optimal vaccine available against its four distinct serotypes: DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, and DENV4. A central challenge in dengue vaccine development is achieving balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, as partial protection can lead to antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), increasing the risk of severe disease upon secondary infection. Methods We developed a tetravalent mRNA vaccine encoding the prM-E proteins from each DENV serotype, formulated in lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). The vaccine was administered intramuscularly to C57BL/6J mice. Each dose contained a total of 5 μg mRNA (1.25 μg per serotype) and was given at 4-week intervals for three immunizations. Germinal center (GC) B cell responses and tissue-resident memory T (Trm) cell induction were analyzed in comparison with recombinant Envelope (rE) protein formulated with Alum. Results The tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicited strong neutralizing antibody responses against all four serotypes, producing titers of 5481, 4632, 12,179, and 5006 for DENV1-4, respectively. Passive transfer of sera from vaccinated mice conferred complete protection in AG129 mice (IFN-α/β/γR-/-) challenged with lethal DENV2, resulting in 100% survival. By day 14, the prM-E mRNA-LNP group exhibited a two-fold higher frequency of CD38^lowGL7+ GC B cells than the rE + Alum group, indicating enhanced GC B cell activity. Intradermal (ID) vaccination induced significantly higher Trm cell formation in the skin compared to intramuscular delivery, showing approximately four-fold increases following ID prime-boost immunization. Conclusion These findings show that the tetravalent prM-E mRNA-LNP vaccine elicits strong humoral and tissue-resident cellular immunity against all DENV serotypes. The results underscore its robust immunogenicity and protective efficacy, supporting further development of mRNA-based dengue vaccines for broad and durable protection. papers.title: I﻿nfrared thermal imaging to determine temperature parameters of dengue vector habitats across ecological regions of Nepal: a pilot feasibility study.
papers.abstract: Dengue is a major vector-borne disease in Nepal, driven by container-breeding Aedes mosquitoes that thrive in domestic, urban settings. Its risk is increasing from the lowland Terai to the Hill and Mountain regions due to urbanisation and global warming. Practical and innovative approaches are needed to better understand the impact on Aedes mosquito habitats that are the main targets for vector control. We conducted a pilot feasibility study to characterise Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus breeding sites, examine physicochemical parameters (total dissolved solids, pH, salinity, dissolved oxygen), and explore the utility of infrared thermal imaging as a novel tool for measuring temperature parameters of habitats across distinct ecological regions. We found that plastic containers, tin/metal items, and rubber tyres were common breeding sites. The dengue vectors Ae. albopictus were identified in a variety of container types across most locations. Overall, there was reasonable agreement between the thermal camera and standard thermometer, although the camera recorded approximately 1 °C lower and showed divergence at higher temperatures. Most aquatic habitat temperatures were within an optimal mosquito breeding range (mid-20s to low 30s °C) and lower than non-breeding site temperatures. The breeding site water temperatures in the Terai region were ~ 4 °C higher than the Mid-Hill and Mountain regions. Aquatic habitat temperatures were also found to be significantly correlated with dissolved oxygen. Thermal imaging case studies provided key visual insights into varying temperatures in complex Aedes microclimates. Notably, inner rubber tyre temperatures remained relatively stable despite significant external temperature fluctuations and external tyre temperatures exceeding 50 °C. Thermal imaging shows promise for the field characterisation of mosquito breeding sites, but it is not interchangeable with standard thermometry without qualification, including calibration and uncertainty analysis.

Its risk is increasing from the lowland Terai to the Hill and Mountain regions due to urbanisation and global warming. Practical and innovative approaches are needed to better understand the impact on Aedes mosquito habitats that are the main targets for vector control. We conducted a pilot feasibility study to characterise Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus breeding sites, examine physicochemical parameters (total dissolved solids, pH, salinity, dissolved oxygen), and explore the utility of infrared thermal imaging as a novel tool for measuring temperature parameters of habitats across distinct ecological regions. We found that plastic containers, tin/metal items, and rubber tyres were common breeding sites. The dengue vectors Ae. albopictus were identified in a variety of container types across most locations. Overall, there was reasonable agreement between the thermal camera and standard thermometer, although the camera recorded approximately 1 °C lower and showed divergence at higher temperatures. Most aquatic habitat temperatures were within an optimal mosquito breeding range (mid-20s to low 30s °C) and lower than non-breeding site temperatures. The breeding site water temperatures in the Terai region were ~ 4 °C higher than the Mid-Hill and Mountain regions. Aquatic habitat temperatures were also found to be significantly correlated with dissolved oxygen. Thermal imaging case studies provided key visual insights into varying temperatures in complex Aedes microclimates. Notably, inner rubber tyre temperatures remained relatively stable despite significant external temperature fluctuations and external tyre temperatures exceeding 50 °C. Thermal imaging shows promise for the field characterisation of mosquito breeding sites, but it is not interchangeable with standard thermometry without qualification, including calibration and uncertainty analysis.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在尼泊尔不同的生态区域(特莱、丘陵、山区)进行了一项试点可行性研究,以检查埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的繁殖地点及其理化参数。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究描述了繁殖地点的特征,测量了物理化学参数(总溶解固体、pH、盐度、溶解氧),并根据测量栖息地温度的标准测温法评估了红外热成像。
elements_zh.main_results: 塑料容器、锡/金属物品和橡胶轮胎是常见的繁殖地。热成像与标准温度计相当一致,但记录温度较低约 1°C,在较高温度下出现偏差。大多数水生栖息地的温度都在蚊子的最佳繁殖范围内(20 摄氏度到 30 摄氏度以下),并且低于非繁殖地。

papers.title: A real-world study on hospital and economic burden of dengue fever in French overseas territories.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Dengue incidence significantly increased in recent years, representing a public health threat in French overseas territories. Real-world data on its burden is lacking by territory/age groups. OBJECTIVES: To describe the hospital burden and associated costs of dengue in French overseas territories. METHODS: Using the French national hospital database (PMSI), dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana (FG), and La Réunion were identified over 2017-2024. Hospitalization rates per 100,000 all-cause hospitalizations were calculated overall and during epidemic periods (EPs). Within EPs, patients and stays characteristics and costs were reported. Analyses were conducted by age groups/territories. RESULTS: Over 2017-2024, 8,399 patients were hospitalized, 95.7% during EPs. Hospitalization rates were 2.6 times higher during EPs than overall and were the highest in patients aged 5-19. Hospitalizations mostly involved women and mean age ranged from 28.2 (FG) to 51.3 (La Réunion) years. Mean hospitalization duration ranged from 3.4 (FG) to 5.1 (La Réunion) days, and admissions via emergency room were most frequent in La Réunion (91.8%). Median (Q1-Q3) cost per hospitalization ranged from €1,403 (€846-€2,876) (FG) to €3,385 (€989- €7,119) (La Réunion). CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the substantial dengue hospital burden, particularly in 5-19-year-old, with variations across French overseas territories. Preventive strategies, including vaccination could reduce this burden.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue incidence has risen substantially in French overseas territories, yet real-world data on its hospital and economic burden by territory and age group remain scarce. The study aimed to quantify the hospital burden and associated costs of dengue in these regions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study used the French national hospital database (PMSI) to identify dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana, and La Réunion from 2017 to 2024. Analyses were conducted by age groups and territories.
analysis.methods: Hospitalization rates per 100,000 all-cause hospitalizations were calculated overall and during epidemic periods. Patient and stay characteristics and costs were reported specifically within epidemic periods.
analysis.main_results: Over 2017–2024, 8,399 patients were hospitalized, with 95.7% occurring during epidemic periods. Hospitalization rates were 2.6 times higher during epidemic periods than overall and were highest in patients aged 5–19 years. Mean hospitalization duration ranged from 3.4 days (French Guiana) to 5.1 days (La Réunion), and median hospitalization cost ranged from €1,403 (French Guiana) to €3,385 (La Réunion).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights a substantial dengue hospital burden, particularly among children aged 5–19 years, with marked territorial variation in duration and cost. This real-world evidence underscores the need for targeted preventive strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support prioritizing vaccination and other preventive measures in high-burden territories and age groups to reduce hospitalizations and associated costs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on administrative hospital data, which may lack clinical detail and underestimate non-hospitalized cases, limiting generalizability and causal inference. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This real-world study quantified the hospital and economic burden of dengue in French overseas territories from 2017 to 2024 using national hospital data. Among 8,399 hospitalized patients, 95.7% occurred during epidemic periods, with hospitalization rates 2.6 times higher than non-epidemic periods. The highest burden was observed in children aged 5–19 years, with mean hospital stays ranging from 3.4 to 5.1 days and median costs from €1,403 to €3,385 across territories. The study highlights substantial territorial variation in duration and cost, emphasizing the need for targeted preventive strategies, including vaccination, to mitigate the burden.

papers.title_zh: 关于法国海外领土 登革热 医院和经济负担的真实世界研究。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Dengue incidence significantly increased in recent years, representing a public health threat in French overseas territories. Real-world data on its burden is lacking by territory/age groups. OBJECTIVES: To describe the hospital burden and associated costs of dengue in French overseas territories. METHODS: Using the French national hospital database (PMSI), dengue hospitalizations in Martinique, Guadeloupe, French Guiana (FG), and La Réunion were identified over 2017-2024. Hospitalization rates per 100,000 all-cause hospitalizations were calculated overall and during epidemic periods (EPs). Within EPs, patients and stays characteristics and costs were reported. Analyses were conducted by age groups/territories. RESULTS: Over 2017-2024, 8,399 patients were hospitalized, 95.7% during EPs. Hospitalization rates were 2.6 times higher during EPs than overall and were the highest in patients aged 5-19. Hospitalizations mostly involved women and mean age ranged from 28.2 (FG) to 51.3 (La Réunion) years. Mean hospitalization duration ranged from 3.4 (FG) to 5.1 (La Réunion) days, and admissions via emergency room were most frequent in La Réunion (91.8%). Median (Q1-Q3) cost per hospitalization ranged from €1,403 (€846-€2,876) (FG) to €3,385 (€989- €7,119) (La Réunion). CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights the substantial dengue hospital burden, particularly in 5-19-year-old, with variations across French overseas territories. Preventive strategies, including vaccination could reduce this burden.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:登革热 发病率 近年来显着增加,对法国海外领土的公共卫生构成威胁。地区/年龄组缺乏有关其负担的现实数据。目标:描述法国海外领土登革热的医院负担和相关费用。方法:利用法国国家医院数据库 (PMSI),确定了 2017 年至 2024 年马提尼克岛、瓜德罗普岛、法属圭亚那 (FG) 和留尼汪岛的登革热住院情况。计算了总体和流行期间每 100,000 例全因住院的住院率 (EP)。在 EP 中,报告了患者和住院特征以及费用。按年龄组/地区进行分析。结果:2017 年至 2024 年期间,8,399 名患者住院,其中 95.7% 在 EP 期间住院。EP 期间的住院率比总体住院率高 2.6 倍,其中 5-19 岁患者的住院率最高。住院患者大多数为女性,平均年龄从 28.2 岁(FG)到 51.3 岁(留尼汪岛)不等。平均住院时间从 3.4 天(FG)到 5.1 天(留尼汪岛)不等,留尼汪岛通过急诊室入院的频率最高(91.8%)。每次住院费用中位数(第一季度至第三季度)范围从 1,403 欧元(846-2,876 欧元)(FG)到 3,385 欧元(989-7,119 欧元)(留尼汪岛)。结论:这项研究强调了登革热医院的巨大负担,尤其是 5-19 岁的儿童,而且法国海外领土之间存在差异。包括 疫苗接种 在内的预防策略可以减轻这种负担。

papers.title: Temperature variation as a driver of Wolbachia release efficacy: implications for dengue control in warming climates
papers.abstract: Background Wolbachia-based control methods reduce dengue transmission by suppressing Aedes aegypti populations or blocking viral replication, yet their effectiveness across the climatic conditions of endemic regions remains poorly understood. Seasonal and interannual temperature changes shape mosquito dynamics, but how Wolbachia releases perform during anomalous events such as El Nino or heatwaves is largely unknown a gap that limits our ability to optimize release strategies and predict intervention success across different climates. Methodology/Principal Findings To address this gap, we built a mathematical modeling framework that explicitly incorporates temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters together with the seasonal and interannual climate variability characteristic of dengue-endemic regions, coupling a detailed Wolbachia dynamics model with a susceptible infectious recovered (SIR) epidemiological model to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes and trace their downstream impact on disease spread. Higher temperatures eroded both Wolbachia establishment and long-term persistence, sharply narrowing the range of effective release strategies as conditions approached 30 C. Seasonality added a further layer of complexity: the timing of thermal stress relative to Wolbachia frequency, not merely its magnitude, determined whether population replacement succeeded. Interannual shifts, progressive warming, widening seasonal swings, and displaced thermal peaks, each eroded Wolbachia prevalence and stability, with effects that compounded over successive years. Dengue transmission tracked these dynamics closely, with warmer conditions producing larger, earlier outbreaks, and intervention success hinging on how release timing, frequency, and targeting were matched to local thermal conditions. Conclusions/Significance As extreme heat events become more frequent under climate change, release programs that ignore local thermal conditions risk falling short where dengue control is most needed. By elucidating the mechanistic interplay among temperature, Wolbachia, and dengue, our findings help refine Wolbachia release programs to suit different climatic conditions, thereby strengthening dengue control as climate variability intensifies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed because the effectiveness of Wolbachia-based dengue control methods across climatic conditions in endemic regions remains poorly understood, particularly during anomalous events like El Nino or heatwaves.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a mathematical modeling framework that incorporated temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters and climate variability characteristic of dengue-endemic regions, coupling a Wolbachia dynamics model with a susceptible infectious recovered (SIR) epidemiological model.
analysis.methods: The methodology involved building a mathematical model that explicitly incorporates temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters, seasonal and interannual climate variability, and couples Wolbachia dynamics with an SIR epidemiological model to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes.
analysis.main_results: Higher temperatures eroded Wolbachia establishment and long-term persistence, narrowing the range of effective release strategies as conditions approached 30°C; seasonality added complexity as the timing of thermal stress relative to Wolbachia frequency determined population replacement success; interannual shifts, progressive warming, and displaced thermal peaks compounded effects over successive years.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that extreme heat events under climate change risk reducing the effectiveness of Wolbachia release programs where dengue control is most needed, and the novelty lies in elucidating the mechanistic interplay among temperature, Wolbachia, and dengue dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the refinement of Wolbachia release programs to suit different climatic conditions, thereby strengthening dengue control as climate variability intensifies, and highlight the need to match release timing, frequency, and targeting to local thermal conditions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate as the study relies on a mathematical model without empirical validation, and limitations include the lack of real-world data to confirm model predictions under actual climatic conditions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how temperature variation affects the efficacy of Wolbachia-based dengue control methods using a mathematical modeling framework. The model incorporated temperature-dependent Wolbachia parameters and climate variability to evaluate Wolbachia establishment, persistence, and stability under different thermal regimes. Results showed that higher temperatures eroded Wolbachia effectiveness, seasonality added complexity to release success, and interannual climate shifts compounded negative effects over time. The findings highlight that extreme heat events under climate change may reduce Wolbachia program effectiveness where dengue control is most needed, emphasizing the need to tailor release strategies to local thermal conditions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究是必要的,因为基于沃尔巴克氏体的登革热控制方法在流行地区的气候条件下的有效性仍然知之甚少,特别是在厄尔尼诺或热浪等异常事件期间。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了一个数学模型框架,该框架结合了温度依赖性沃尔巴克氏体参数和登革热流行地区的气候变化特征,将沃尔巴克氏体动力学模型与易感感染恢复(SIR)流行病学模型相结合。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法涉及建立一个数学模型,明确地将与温度相关的沃尔巴克氏体参数、季节性和年际气候变化结合起来,并将沃尔巴克氏体动力学与 SIR 流行病学模型结合起来,以评估不同热状况下沃尔巴克氏体的建立、持久性和稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 较高的温度会侵蚀沃尔巴克氏体的建立和长期持久性,当条件接近 30°C 时,会缩小有效释放策略的范围;季节性增加了复杂性,因为与沃尔巴克氏体频率相关的热应激时间决定了种群更替的成功;年际变化、逐渐变暖和热峰偏移连续几年加剧了影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,气候变化下的极端高温事件可能会降低最需要控制登革热的沃尔巴克氏体释放计划的有效性,而新颖之处在于阐明温度、沃尔巴克氏体和登革热动力学之间的机制相互作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件提供信息,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制,并强调需要将释放时间、频率和目标与当地的热条件相匹配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于未经实证验证的数学模型,并且局限性包括缺乏真实世界数据来证实实际气候条件下的模型预测。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 基于沃尔巴克氏体的控制方法通过抑制埃及伊蚊种群或阻断病毒复制来减少登革热 传播,但其在流行地区气候条件下的有效性仍知之甚少。季节性和年际温度变化影响着蚊子的动态,但沃尔巴克氏体在厄尔尼诺或热浪等异常事件期间的释放情况在很大程度上尚不清楚,这一差距限制了我们优化释放策略和预测不同气候下干预成功的能力。方法/主要发现为了解决这一差距,我们建立了一个数学模型框架,明确地将温度依赖性沃尔巴克氏体参数与登革热流行地区的季节性和年际气候变化特征结合在一起,将详细的沃尔巴克氏体动力学模型与易感感染恢复(SIR)流行病学模型相结合,以评估沃尔巴克氏体在不同热状况下的建立、持久性和稳定性,并追踪其对疾病传播的下游影响。较高的温度会侵蚀沃尔巴克氏体的建立和长期持续性,当条件接近 30°C 时,有效释放策略的范围急剧缩小。季节性又增加了一层复杂性:与沃尔巴克氏体频率相关的热应激时间,而不仅仅是其大小,决定了种群更替是否成功。年际变化、逐渐变暖、季节性波动扩大和热峰移位,每一个都侵蚀着沃尔巴克氏体 患病率 和稳定性,其影响在连续几年中加剧。登革热 传播 密切跟踪这些动态,温暖的条件会产生更大、更早的 暴发,干预的成功取决于释放时间、频率和目标如何与当地的热条件相匹配。结论/意义 随着气候变化导致极端高温事件变得更加频繁,忽视当地高温条件的发布计划可能会在最需要控制登革热的地方出现不足。通过阐明温度、沃尔巴克氏体和登革热之间的机制相互作用,我们的研究结果有助于完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,气候变化下的极端高温事件可能会降低最需要控制登革热的沃尔巴克氏体释放计划的有效性,而新颖之处在于阐明温度、沃尔巴克氏体和登革热动力学之间的机制相互作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为完善沃尔巴克氏体释放计划以适应不同的气候条件提供信息,从而在气候变化加剧时加强登革热控制,并强调需要将释放时间、频率和目标与当地的热条件相匹配。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究依赖于未经实证验证的数学模型,并且局限性包括缺乏真实世界数据来证实实际气候条件下的模型预测。

papers.title: Pregnant women as a reference population to estimate dengue under-reporting: methodological proposal and application in São Paulo State, Brazil.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To propose and apply a methodology to estimate the under-reporting of probable dengue cases among non-pregnant women, using the incidence in pregnant women as a reference. METHODS: Ecological study using data on probable dengue cases reported in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, between January and June 2024. Assuming that pregnant women have a higher likelihood of diagnosis and notification due to prenatal follow-up, this group was taken as a reference to calculate the under-reporting of dengue incidence among non-pregnant women aged 18 to 45 years. The association between under-reporting and factors such as Family Health Strategy coverage, number of Primary Health Care Units per thousand women at reproductive age, and degree of urbanization was assessed using logistic regression. Spatial autocorrelation analysis of under-reporting was also performed. RESULTS: Of the 645 municipalities analyzed, 108 (16.7%) showed evidence of under-reporting, ranging from 1% to 95%. It was estimated that 8,624 dengue cases were not detected among non-pregnant women during the study period. No statistically significant associations were found between the analyzed factors and under-reporting. Spatial analysis identified significant clusters of municipalities with underreporting in the northwestern region of the state. CONCLUSION: The proposed methodology may identify areas with probable underreporting and support analyses of determinants of surveillance system sensitivity, thereby helping to guide interventions. Although potentially applicable to other notifiable diseases, comparisons between pregnant and non-pregnant women should be interpreted with caution due to differences in risk, vulnerability, and diagnostic criteria.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所提出的方法可以识别可能漏报的领域,并支持对 监测 系统敏感性决定因素的分析,从而帮助指导干预措施。尽管可能适用于其他法定疾病,但由于风险、脆弱性和诊断标准的差异,应谨慎解释孕妇和非孕妇之间的比较。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到其生态设计和孕妇通知率较高的假设的限制,这可能无法完全解释风险和诊断标准的差异。由于研究的设计和解释组间比较时需要谨慎,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Household Characteristics, Residents’ Behaviors, and Seasonal Factors Associated With the Presence and Persistence of Aedes aegypti in a Dengue-Endemic Area
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to evaluate the association between household characteristics, residents' preventive behaviors, seasonal factors, and the presence and persistence of Aedes aegypti in a dengue-endemic area. The findings are intended to identify modifiable household and behavioral factors that can inform targeted, seasonally adapted vector control strategies. Methodology: This prospective cohort study was conducted in San Pedro Pochutla, Oaxaca, Mexico. A total of 68 inhabited dwellings were selected and characterized on a single occasion according to their structure, degree of marginalization, vulnerability, and environment. Over a period of 12 months, seven entomological evaluations were performed indoors and outdoors to assess the presence, persistence, and seasonal patterns of Aedes aegypti. Results: A total of 476 visits were conducted, identifying 494 breeding sites positive for Aedes aegypti larvae or pupae. A total of 48.5% of the homes studied were positive on at least two occasions, with marked temporal variation, particularly during the rainy season (67.7%). Most breeding sites were located outdoors (96%), predominantly in controllable containers (73%). The most important habitats were drums, barrels/sinks/tubs/pools, cans/buckets, tires, and kitchen/washing utensils (72.8%). The characteristics of the dwelling that represented a risk for the presence and persistence of Aedes aegypti were the lack of mosquito nets on doors (OR=1.31, 95% CI=1.08-5.20), lack of pavilions on beds (OR=1.95, 95% CI=1.16-8.35), animals in the household (OR=2.27, 95% CI=1.19-7.63), and not applying insecticide indoors (OR=1.64, 95% CI=1.10-4.21). Conclusion: Household conditions, human behavior, and seasonal variation significantly influence the presence and persistence of Aedes aegypti. These findings can inform targeted vector control strategies, particularly focusing on modifiable risk factors and seasonal interventions.

A total of 48.5% of the homes studied were positive on at least two occasions, with marked temporal variation, particularly during the rainy season (67.7%). Most breeding sites were located outdoors (96%), predominantly in controllable containers (73%). The most important habitats were drums, barrels/sinks/tubs/pools, cans/buckets, tires, and kitchen/washing utensils (72.8%). Conclusion: Household conditions, human behavior, and seasonal variation significantly influence the presence and persistence of Aedes aegypti. These findings can inform targeted vector control strategies, particularly focusing on modifiable risk factors and seasonal interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估家庭特征、居民的预防行为、季节性因素以及登革热流行地区埃及伊蚊的存在和持续性之间的关联。研究结果旨在确定可改变的家庭和行为因素,这些因素可以为有针对性的、季节性调整的 媒介 控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究在墨西哥瓦哈卡州圣佩德罗波楚特拉进行。一次性选择了 68 处居住住宅,并根据其结构、边缘化程度、脆弱性和环境进行了特征分析。
elements_zh.methods: 在 12 个月的时间内,在室内和室外进行了七次昆虫学评估,以评估埃及伊蚊的存在、持久性和季节性模式。代表埃及伊蚊存在和持续存在风险的住宅特征是门上没有蚊帐、床上没有凉亭、家里有动物以及室内没有使用杀虫剂。
elements_zh.main_results: 总共进行了 476 次访问,确定了 494 个埃及伊蚊幼虫或蛹呈阳性的繁殖地点。总共 48.5% 的研究家庭至少两次呈阳性,且存在明显的时间变化,特别是在雨季 (67.7%)。大多数繁殖地点位于室外(96%),主要在可控容器中(73%)。最重要的栖息地是鼓、桶/水槽/浴缸/水池、罐头/水桶、轮胎和厨房/洗涤用具(72.8%)。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 它们提供了对导致埃及伊蚊在登革热流行地区持续存在的环境和行为因素的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在一个地点进行的,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是强有力的,因为它基于对繁殖地点的直接观察以及与家庭和行为因素的关联。

papers.title: Characterization of Non-Neutralizing Antibody Responses in a Dengue Virus-4 Human Challenge Model 2243013
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Primary infection with one of the four dengue viruses (DENV-1—4) induces serotype-specific antibodies (Abs) that confer durable protection and cross-reactive Abs that offer transient immunity. While neutralizing Ab titers are commonly used to assess protection, they do not reliably predict disease outcome, and the role of Abs that mediate non-neutralizing effector functions remains poorly understood. We present an approach to evaluate the non-neutralizing Ab (nNAb) response to experimental DENV infection in humans. Methods In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue—naïve subjects were subcutaneously inoculated with a slightly attenuated, live DENV-4 strain, H-241. Plasma was collected from pre- and 6 months post-infection to measure Ab-dependent complement deposition, Ab-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and Ab-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). All assays used target cells infected with DENV or transfected to express DENV-derived surface-bound NS1 protein. Results Infected subjects generated DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs and anti-NS1 Abs that facilitated monocyte-mediated phagocytosis of target cells. DENV-4-specific Abs also mediated NK cell activation in a subset of subjects. Conclusion Future work will focus on extending this functional study to recipients of a tetravalent vaccine followed by DENV-1 challenge to investigate how nNAbs correlate with disease protection/risk, and broaden our understanding of immune defense against dengue beyond neutralizing Abs. Funding Source DOD Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

source_records.abstract: Abstract Introduction Primary infection with one of the four dengue viruses (DENV-1—4) induces serotype-specific antibodies (Abs) that confer durable protection and cross-reactive Abs that offer transient immunity. While neutralizing Ab titers are commonly used to assess protection, they do not reliably predict disease outcome, and the role of Abs that mediate non-neutralizing effector functions remains poorly understood. We present an approach to evaluate the non-neutralizing Ab (nNAb) response to experimental DENV infection in humans. Methods In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue—naïve subjects were subcutaneously inoculated with a slightly attenuated, live DENV-4 strain, H-241. Plasma was collected from pre- and 6 months post-infection to measure Ab-dependent complement deposition, Ab-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and Ab-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). All assays used target cells infected with DENV or transfected to express DENV-derived surface-bound NS1 protein. Results Infected subjects generated DENV-4-specific complement-fixing Abs and anti-NS1 Abs that facilitated monocyte-mediated phagocytosis of target cells. DENV-4-specific Abs also mediated NK cell activation in a subset of subjects. Conclusion Future work will focus on extending this functional study to recipients of a tetravalent vaccine followed by DENV-1 challenge to investigate how nNAbs correlate with disease protection/risk, and broaden our understanding of immune defense against dengue beyond neutralizing Abs. Funding Source DOD Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

analysis.summary_en: This study characterized non-neutralizing antibody responses in a DENV-4 human challenge model. In a phase 1 open-label study, 14 dengue-naïve subjects were inoculated with a live attenuated DENV-4 strain. Plasma was analyzed for Ab-dependent complement deposition, phagocytosis, and cytotoxicity using DENV-infected or NS1-expressing target cells. elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来关于 nNAb 如何与疾病保护或风险相关的研究提供了信息,可能会改善 疫苗 的开发和对登革热免疫的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量较小且只关注单一血清型的限制,但使用功能性抗体反应的直接测量提供了中等的证据强度。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 四种 登革病毒 (DENV-1-4) 之一的初次感染会诱导血清型特异性抗体 (Ab),提供持久的保护,并产生交叉反应抗体,提供短暂的免疫。虽然中和抗体滴度通常用于评估保护作用,但它们不能可靠地预测疾病结果,并且对介导非中和效应功能的抗体的作用仍知之甚少。我们提出了一种评估人类实验性 DENV 感染的非中和抗体 (nNAb) 反应的方法。方法 在一项 1 期开放标签研究中,14 名未接触过登革热的受试者皮下接种了轻微减毒的活 DENV-4 毒株 H-241。感染前和感染后 6 个月收集血浆,以测量 Ab 依赖性补体沉积、Ab 依赖性细胞吞噬作用和 Ab 依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC)。所有测定均使用感染 DENV 或转染表达 DENV 衍生表面结合 NS1 蛋白的靶细胞。结果感染受试者产生 DENV-4 特异性补体固定抗体和抗 NS1 抗体,促进单核细胞介导的靶细胞吞噬作用。DENV-4 特异性抗体还在一部分受试者中介导 NK 细胞活化。结论 未来的工作将侧重于将这项功能研究扩展到四价 疫苗 的接受者,然后进行 DENV-1 攻击,以研究 nNAbs 如何与疾病保护/风险相关,并扩大我们对中和 Abs 之外的登革热免疫防御的理解。资金来源 DOD 主题类别 病毒免疫学 (VIR)

papers.title: Unmanaged plastic waste significantly increases dengue burden
papers.abstract: Abstract Plastic pollution is increasingly recognized as a global environmental challenge, yet its role as a measurable driver of infectious disease risk remains poorly quantified. We developed a material-specific extension of the WHO-recommended Breteau Index (BI) that incorporated discarded waste into routine Aedes larval surveillance and evaluated its ability to explain dengue risk using nationwide surveillance data from Sri Lanka. We found that discarded non-biodegradable waste represented a major breeding habitat associated with dengue transmission, with plastic containers comprising the dominant material fraction. Waste-associated breeding habitats accounted for 30–34% of reported dengue burden nationally during 2024–2025. An empirically derived material-partitioning approach further estimated that plastic-associated habitats contributed approximately 22–23% of dengue burden across sentinel districts. Together, this material-specific surveillance framework translates unmanaged environmental waste into measurable infectious disease risk, providing a practical indicator instrument for both downstream vector surveillance and upstream waste-management and plastic policies.
